id: # Runtime voice: science talk. After an experiment the kerbal who did it reports and Mission Control answers.
# The format is explained at the top of reports.tsv. Kind science_talk, ids rt_st_<name>_<seq>, one row per line.
# The kerbal speaks the odd lines, Mission Control the even ones (who=mc in the when: Mission Control starts).
# Only line 1 has a when: on= the experiment (on=science: any experiment), a=scientist (the kerbal's job), a
# situation and checks. Every line of a talk without a when keeps a version without values, so it always fills.
# Values for science: {sci} {sci_left} {sci_first} {sci_flight} {exp_runs} {exp}, and what the instruments read:
# {temp_c} (degrees C) {press_kpa} (kPa, 0 in a vacuum) {grav_g} (g at this height). Piper says them, no audio is built.

spanish: Informe: todo verde, todo raro, todo bonito. | Informe de tripulación: verde, raro y bonito. Todo. | Informe desde {biome}: todo verde, todo raro, todo bonito.
english: Report: everything green, everything weird, everything pretty. | Crew report: green, weird and pretty. All of it. | Report from {biome}: everything green, everything weird, everything pretty.

spanish: Recibido. Va a la carpeta de cosas bonitas. | Recibido. Eso va a la carpeta bonita. | Recibido. {sci} puntos para la carpeta de cosas bonitas.
english: Copy. Filing it under pretty things. | Copy. That goes in the pretty folder. | Copy. {sci} points for the pretty things folder.

spanish: Informe de tripulación listo. Todos seguimos vivos. | Informe de tripulación hecho. Todos vivos. | Informe de tripulación de {vessel} listo. Todos seguimos vivos.
english: Crew report ready. We're all still alive. | Crew report done. Everybody is alive. | {vessel} crew report ready. We're all still alive.

spanish: Excelente. Ese es el mejor tipo de informe. | Genial. Es mi tipo de informe favorito. | Excelente, {kerbal}. Ese es el mejor tipo de informe.
english: Excellent. That's the best kind of report. | Great. That's my favorite kind of report. | Excellent, {kerbal}. That's the best kind of report.

spanish: He mirado a mi alrededor y lo anoté todo. | He revisado el entorno y lo anoté todo. | He mirado todo {biome} y lo anoté todo.
english: I looked around and wrote it all down. | I checked the surroundings and noted everything. | I looked at all of {biome} and wrote it all down.

spanish: Gracias. Dime si anotaste algo útil. | Gracias. ¿Algo de eso importaba? | Gracias. Vale {sci} puntos, así que algo útil había.
english: Thanks. Tell me if you wrote anything useful. | Thanks. Did any of it matter? | Thanks. It's worth {sci} points, so something was useful.

spanish: Informe enviado. Tiene tres líneas y una mancha de café. | Informe enviado. Tiene tres líneas y una mancha de café.
english: Report sent. Three lines and a coffee stain. | Report sent. It has three lines and a coffee stain.

spanish: Recibido. La mancha de café también es ciencia. | Entendido. La mancha cuenta como hallazgo. | Recibido. La mancha de café de {here} también es ciencia.
english: Copy. The coffee stain is science too. | Got it. We'll call the stain a finding. | Copy. A coffee stain from {here} is science too.

spanish: Estado de la tripulación: cansados, pero con ganas. | Estado de la tripulación: con sueño y listos. | Día {day}. Estado de la tripulación: cansados, pero con ganas.
english: Crew status: tired, but eager. | Crew status: sleepy and ready. | Day {day}. Crew status: tired, but eager.

spanish: Perfecto. Con ganas se llega lejos. | Bien. Con entusiasmo se llega lejos.
english: Perfect. Eager gets you far. | Good. Enthusiasm gets people far.

spanish: Hice el informe de tripulación. Fue fácil, solo hay que mirar. | Informe de tripulación hecho. Fue fácil, solo miré. | Informe de tripulación desde {here}. Fácil, solo hay que mirar.
english: Crew report done. Easy, you just look. | Crew report done. It was easy, I just looked. | Crew report from {here}. Easy, you just look.

spanish: Copy. Mirar es el noventa por ciento de la ciencia. | Copy. Mirar es casi todo el trabajo.
english: Copy. Looking is ninety percent of science. | Copy. Looking is most of the job.

spanish: Todo normal por aquí. Bueno, normal para nosotros. | Aquí todo normal. Para nosotros, al menos. | Todo normal en {biome}. Bueno, normal para nosotros.
english: All normal around here. Well, normal for us. | Everything is normal here. For us, anyway. | All normal in {biome}. Well, normal for us.

spanish: Entendido. Nuestro normal ya da miedo. | Entendido. Nuestro normal da un poco de miedo.
english: Understood. Our normal is already scary. | Understood. Our normal is a little scary.

spanish: Informe: hay un olor raro, pero con cariño. | Informe: un olor raro, pero bonito. | Informe desde {vessel}: hay un olor raro, pero con cariño.
english: Report: there's a weird smell, but a fond one. | Report: an odd smell, in a nice way. | Report from {vessel}: there's a weird smell, but a fond one.

spanish: Anotado. Ese olor ya está en el archivo. | Anotado. El olor ya es oficial.
english: Noted. That smell is in the file now. | Noted. The smell is officially on record.

spanish: Estoy escribiendo el informe con un lápiz que no para quieto. | Escribo el informe con un lápiz inquieto.
english: Writing the report with a pencil that won't stay put. | I'm writing the report with a restless pencil.

spanish: Bien. Sujeta el lápiz, no el informe. | Bien. Agarra bien ese lápiz. | Bien, {kerbal}. Sujeta el lápiz, no el informe.
english: Good. Hold the pencil, not the report. | Good. Keep a grip on the pencil. | Good, {kerbal}. Hold the pencil, not the report.

spanish: Informe terminado. El resumen es: bien. | Informe terminado. En resumen: bien. | Informe terminado en {biome}. El resumen es: bien.
english: Report finished. The summary is: good. | Report finished. In short: fine. | Report finished in {biome}. The summary is: good.

spanish: Resumen aprobado. Corto y claro. | Aprobado. Corto y claro. | Resumen aprobado. {sci} puntos por una palabra. Récord.
english: Summary approved. Short and clear. | Approved. Short and clear. | Summary approved. {sci} points for one word. A record.

spanish: Revisé a la tripulación. Todos tienen dos brazos. | Revisé a todos. Todos tienen dos brazos. | Revisé a la tripulación de {vessel}. Todos tienen dos brazos.
english: I checked the crew. Everyone has two arms. | I checked everyone. They all have two arms. | I checked the {vessel} crew. Everyone has two arms.

spanish: Excelente. Eso ya es medio informe. | Bien. Eso solo ya es medio informe.
english: Excellent. That's half a report already. | Good. That alone is half a report.

spanish: Anoto lo que veo. Mucho espacio y poca gente. | Observación: mucho espacio, poca gente. | Anoto lo que veo en {biome}. Mucho espacio y poca gente.
english: Noting what I see. Lots of space, few people. | Observation: much space, not many people. | Noting what I see in {biome}. Lots of space, few people.

spanish: Observación valiosa. La ponemos en el informe. | Gran observación. Al informe. | Observación valiosa. Vale {sci} puntos.
english: Valuable observation. It goes in the report. | Great observation. Into the report. | Valuable observation. It's worth {sci} points.

spanish: Control, ¿qué debo poner en el informe de tripulación? | Control, ¿qué tiene que decir el informe de tripulación?
english: Control, what do I put in the crew report? | Control, what should the crew report say?

spanish: Lo que ves. Y sé amable con el piloto. | Solo lo que ves. No seas duro con el piloto.
english: What you see. And be kind to the pilot. | Just what you see. Go easy on the pilot.

spanish: Mi informe de la tripulación dice que falta sitio para las piernas. | En mi informe de tripulación: no hay sitio para las piernas. | Informe de {vessel}: falta sitio para las piernas.
english: My crew report says there's not enough leg room. | In my crew report: no room for legs. | {vessel} report: there's not enough leg room.

spanish: Anotado. Se lo diremos al arquitecto. | Anotado. Se lo pasamos al arquitecto.
english: Noted. We'll tell the architect. | Noted. We'll pass it to the architect.

spanish: He contado a la tripulación dos veces. Salen números distintos. | Conté a la tripulación dos veces y salieron dos respuestas. | He contado a la tripulación dos veces. Somos {crew}. Creo.
english: I counted the crew twice. Different numbers. | I counted the crew twice and got two answers. | I counted the crew twice. We're {crew}. I think.

spanish: Cuenta otra vez. Y no te cuentes dos veces. | Otra vez. No te cuentes dos veces.
english: Count again. And don't count yourself twice. | Try once more. Don't count yourself twice.

spanish: Informe científico: la tripulación es muy simpática. | Informe científico: la tripulación es bastante amable.
english: Scientific report: the crew is very nice. | Scientific report: the crew is quite friendly.

spanish: Dato muy valioso. Sin fuente, pero valioso. | Valioso, aunque sin fuente. | Dato muy valioso. Sin fuente, pero vale {sci} puntos.
english: Very valuable data. No source, but valuable. | Valuable, even if unsourced. | Very valuable data. No source, but it's worth {sci} points.

spanish: Observo a la tripulación. Se comportan de forma interesante. | Observo a la tripulación. Actúan de forma interesante. | Observo a la tripulación en {here}. Se comportan de forma interesante.
english: Observing the crew. They behave in an interesting way. | I'm watching the crew. They act interestingly. | Observing the crew on {here}. They behave in an interesting way.

spanish: Describe interesante, por favor. | Por favor, define interesante. | Define interesante, {kerbal}.
english: Define interesting, please. | Please define interesting. | Define interesting, {kerbal}.

spanish: La tripulación tiene hambre. Esto es importante para la ciencia. | La tripulación tiene hambre. La ciencia tiene que saberlo. | Día {day}. La tripulación tiene hambre. Esto es importante para la ciencia.
english: The crew is hungry. This matters for science. | The crew is hungry. Science needs to know. | Day {day}. The crew is hungry. This matters for science.

spanish: Muy importante. Anotado en prioridad alta. | Muy importante. Anotado como prioridad máxima.
english: Very important. Marked high priority. | Very important. Logged as top priority.

spanish: Informe: vistas bonitas, silla incómoda. | Informe: buena vista, mala silla. | Informe: vistas bonitas de {here}, silla incómoda.
english: Report: nice views, uncomfortable seat. | Report: good view, bad seat. | Report: nice views of {here}, uncomfortable seat.

spanish: Gracias. Mandaremos una silla mejor.
english: Thanks. We'll look into a better seat.

spanish: Mi informe tiene un dibujo. No sé si cuenta. | Hay un dibujo en mi informe. ¿Cuenta? | Mi informe tiene un dibujo de {biome}. No sé si cuenta.
english: My report has a drawing. Not sure if it counts. | There's a drawing in my report. Does it count? | My report has a drawing of {biome}. Not sure if it counts.

spanish: Cuenta. Si es bonito, cuenta doble. | Cuenta. Los dibujos bonitos cuentan doble. | Cuenta. {sci} puntos. Si es bonito, cuenta doble.
english: It counts. If it's pretty, it counts double. | It counts. Pretty drawings count double. | It counts. {sci} points. If it's pretty, it counts double.

spanish: Hice el informe, pero lo leí al revés. | Escribí el informe y lo leí del final al principio.
english: I made the report, but I read it backwards. | I wrote the report and read it back to front.

spanish: Aquí todos leemos al revés. Está bien. | Aquí todos leemos al revés. Sin problema.
english: Here we all read backwards. That's fine. | We all read backwards here. No problem.

spanish: La tripulación está de buen humor. Es sospechoso. | La tripulación está alegre. Eso es sospechoso. | La tripulación de {vessel} está de buen humor. Es sospechoso.
english: The crew is in a good mood. Suspicious. | The crew is cheerful. That's suspicious. | The {vessel} crew is in a good mood. Suspicious.

spanish: Sospechoso e inusual. Lo anotamos. | Sospechoso y raro. Anotado.
english: Suspicious and unusual. We'll note it. | Suspicious and rare. Noted.

spanish: Informe desde fuera: el traje aguanta y la vista es enorme. | Informe exterior: el traje bien, la vista enorme. | Informe desde fuera en {biome}: el traje aguanta y la vista es enorme.
english: Report from outside: the suit holds and the view is huge. | Outside report: suit is fine, view is enormous. | Report from outside in {biome}: the suit holds and the view is huge.

spanish: Recibido. No te alejes de la nave. | Recibido. No te alejes de la {vessel}.
english: Copy. Don't wander far from the ship. | Copy. Stay close to {vessel}.

spanish: Informe desde fuera: el traje aguanta y yo también. | Informe exterior: traje bien, yo bien. | Llevo {eva_mins} minutos fuera. El traje aguanta y yo también.
english: Report from outside: the suit holds and so do I. | Outside report: suit fine, me fine. | {eva_mins} minutes outside. The suit holds and so do I.

spanish: Recibido. Eso es lo que queremos oír. | Recibido. Justo lo que queremos oír. | Recibido, {kerbal}. Eso es lo que queremos oír.
english: Copy. That's what we like to hear. | Copy. Exactly what we want to hear. | Copy, {kerbal}. That's what we like to hear.

spanish: Estoy fuera. El informe va bien, yo no tanto. | Estoy fuera. El informe va bien, yo no estoy tan seguro.
english: I'm outside. The report is fine, I'm less sure. | I'm outside. The report is going well, I'm less sure.

spanish: Entendido. Respira hondo y sigue. | Entendido. Respira hondo y sigue.
english: Understood. Breathe deep and carry on. | Understood. Deep breath, keep going.

spanish: Informe exterior: la nave parece más pequeña desde aquí. | Informe exterior: la nave se ve pequeña desde aquí fuera. | Informe exterior: {vessel} parece más pequeña desde aquí.
english: Exterior report: the ship looks smaller from here. | Exterior report: the ship looks small from out here. | Exterior report: {vessel} looks smaller from here.

spanish: Copy. No la pierdas de vista. | Copy. Que no se te escape de la vista. | Copy. Estás a {ship_m} metros. No la pierdas de vista.
english: Copy. Don't lose sight of it. | Copy. Keep it in view. | Copy. You're {ship_m} meters out. Don't lose sight of it.

spanish: Informe de la salida: sin problemas con el traje. | Informe de la salida: el traje se porta bien. | Informe de la salida: sin problemas con el traje. Mochila al {jet} por ciento.
english: EVA report: no suit problems. | EVA report: the suit is behaving. | EVA report: no suit problems. Jetpack at {jet} percent.

spanish: Perfecto. Mantén esa buena racha. | Perfecto. Sigue así.
english: Perfect. Keep that streak going. | Perfect. Keep it up.

spanish: Estoy fuera y se oye mi respiración. | Aquí fuera oigo mi propia respiración. | Estoy fuera, sobre {here}, y se oye mi respiración.
english: I'm outside and I can hear myself breathe. | Out here I can hear my own breathing. | I'm outside over {here} and I can hear myself breathe.

spanish: Disfrútalo. Pero no te distraigas. | Disfrútalo. Concéntrate.
english: Enjoy it. But stay focused. | Enjoy it. Stay focused.

spanish: Informe: he saludado a la nave y no contestó. | Informe: he saludado a la nave. Sin respuesta. | Informe: he saludado a {vessel} y no contestó.
english: Report: I waved at the ship and it didn't answer. | Report: I said hello to the ship. No reply. | Report: I waved at {vessel} and it didn't answer.

spanish: Normal. La nave no habla por radio. | Normal. La nave no usa la radio.
english: Normal. The ship doesn't use the radio. | Normal. The ship stays off the radio.

spanish: Informe externo: el casco tiene una mancha. Es mía. | Informe externo: una mancha en el visor. Mía.
english: External report: there's a smudge on the helmet. It's mine. | External report: a smudge on my visor. Mine.

spanish: Entendido. Límpiala después. | Entendido. Límpiala luego.
english: Understood. Clean it later. | Understood. Wipe it afterwards.

spanish: Informe de la salida: veo la nave y la nave me ve. | Informe de la salida: la nave y yo nos miramos. | Informe de la salida: veo a {vessel} y {vessel} me ve.
english: EVA report: I see the ship and the ship sees me. | EVA report: the ship and I are looking at each other. | EVA report: I see {vessel} and {vessel} sees me.

spanish: Bien. Que se miren con cariño. | Bien. Que sea amistoso.
english: Good. Let them look fondly. | Good. Keep it friendly.

spanish: Estoy fuera. Hago nada con mucho esfuerzo. | Ya estoy fuera. Pongo mucho esfuerzo en nada. | Llevo {eva_mins} minutos fuera haciendo nada con mucho esfuerzo.
english: I'm outside. Doing nothing with great effort. | Outside now. Putting a lot of effort into nothing. | {eva_mins} minutes outside, doing nothing with great effort.

spanish: Hacer nada es un buen informe. | Hacer nada es un buen informe. | Hacer nada vale {sci} puntos. Buen informe.
english: Doing nothing makes a fine report. | Doing nothing is a good report. | Doing nothing is worth {sci} points. Good report.

spanish: Informe: di un paseo. Bueno, me moví con ganas. | Informe: un paseo. Más bien un movimiento decidido. | Informe: di un paseo por {biome}. Bueno, me moví con ganas.
english: Report: I took a stroll. Well, moved with intent. | Report: a walk. More of a determined move. | Report: I took a stroll through {biome}. Well, moved with intent.

spanish: Recibido. Moverse con ganas está permitido. | Copy. Moverse con decisión está permitido.
english: Copy. Moving with intent is allowed. | Copy. Determined moving is allowed.

spanish: Estoy fuera tomando notas. Aquí todo parece más grande. | Notas desde fuera. Todo parece más grande. | Estoy fuera tomando notas en {biome}. Aquí todo parece más grande.
english: I'm outside taking notes. Everything looks bigger out here. | Notes from outside. It all looks bigger. | Taking notes outside in {biome}. Everything looks bigger out here.

spanish: Buen trabajo. Escribe con letra clara. | Bien. Letra clara, por favor. | Buen trabajo. Son {sci} puntos. Escribe con letra clara.
english: Good work. Write neatly. | Nice. Neat handwriting, please. | Good work. That's {sci} points. Write neatly.

spanish: Control, el informe de la salida me da vértigo. | Control, escribir este informe me da vértigo.
english: Control, the EVA report is making me dizzy. | Control, writing this EVA report makes me dizzy.

spanish: Respira. Y no mires demasiado. | Respira. No mires demasiado. | Respira, {kerbal}. Y no mires demasiado.
english: Breathe. And don't stare too long. | Breathe. Don't stare too long. | Breathe, {kerbal}. And don't stare too long.

spanish: Escribir un informe con guantes es difícil. | Es difícil escribir un informe con guantes.
english: Writing a report in gloves is hard. | It's hard to write a report wearing gloves.

spanish: Lo sabemos. Por eso la letra sale así. | Lo sabemos. Eso explica la letra.
english: We know. That's why the writing looks like that. | We know. That explains the handwriting.

spanish: Informe desde fuera: la vista es muy bonita. | Informe exterior: vista bonita. | Informe desde fuera: la vista de {here} es muy bonita.
english: Report from outside: the view is very pretty. | Outside report: pretty view. | Report from outside: the view of {here} is very pretty.

spanish: Anota la vista. Y no la desperdicies. | Anota la vista. Aprovéchala.
english: Note the view. And don't waste it. | Note the view. Make the most of it.

spanish: Mi informe de la salida es corto: todo bien, mucho trabajo. | Informe corto de la salida: bien, ocupado. | Mi informe de la salida desde {biome}: todo bien, mucho trabajo.
english: My EVA report is short: all good, lots of work. | Short EVA report: fine, busy. | My EVA report from {biome}: all good, lots of work.

spanish: Corto y claro. Así nos gusta. | Corto y claro. Como nos gusta.
english: Short and clear. We like it. | Short and clear. Just how we like it.

spanish: Se me ha caído algo fuera. Creo que es mi guante. | Algo se me ha escapado. Seguramente mi guante.
english: I dropped something out here. I think it's my glove. | Something got away from me. Probably my glove.

spanish: Recógelo. Es el único que tienes. | Cógelo. Solo tienes uno.
english: Pick it up. It's the only one you have. | Grab it. You only have the one.

spanish: El informe de la salida dice que me aburro un poco. | El informe de la salida dice que me aburro un poquito. | Llevo {eva_mins} minutos fuera. El informe dice que me aburro un poco.
english: My EVA report says I'm a little bored. | The EVA report says I'm slightly bored. | {eva_mins} minutes outside. My report says I'm a little bored.

spanish: Entendido. Te daremos una tarea. | Entendido. Te buscaremos un trabajo.
english: Understood. We'll give you a task. | Understood. We'll find you a job.

spanish: Estoy fuera. ¿Alguien puede tomarme una foto? | Estoy aquí fuera. ¿Alguien me hace una foto? | Estoy fuera, en {biome}. ¿Alguien puede tomarme una foto?
english: I'm outside. Can someone take my picture? | I'm out here. Could someone take a photo of me? | I'm outside, in {biome}. Can someone take my picture?

spanish: Claro. Sonríe detrás del casco. | Claro. Sonríe dentro del casco.
english: Sure. Smile behind the helmet. | Sure. Smile inside the helmet.

spanish: Informe desde fuera: el traje hace un ruidito. | Informe desde fuera: mi traje zumba.
english: Outside report: the suit makes a little noise. | Report from outside: my suit is humming.

spanish: Eso es el aire. Si se calla, avísanos. | Es el aire. Avísanos si para. | Es el aire. La mochila está al {jet} por ciento. Si el traje se calla, avísanos.
english: That's the air. If it goes quiet, tell us. | That's the air. Tell us if it stops. | That's the air. Jetpack is at {jet} percent. If the suit goes quiet, tell us.

spanish: Me siento como una estrella. Pero sin brillar. | Me siento como una estrella. Una que brilla poco.
english: I feel like a star. Just not glowing. | I feel like a star. A dim one.

spanish: Brilla con el trabajo, no con el traje. | Brilla con el trabajo, no con el traje.
english: Shine with your work, not your suit. | Shine through work, not the suit.

spanish: Informe de salida: afuera hay mucho afuera. | Informe de salida: el afuera tiene mucho afuera. | Informe de salida: en {here} hay mucho afuera.
english: EVA report: there's a lot of outside out here. | EVA report: outside has a lot of outside. | EVA report: there's a lot of outside on {here}.

spanish: Muy científico. Lo anotaremos tal cual. | Muy científico. Lo anotamos palabra por palabra. | Muy científico. {sci} puntos, tal cual.
english: Very scientific. We'll log it as is. | Very scientific. Logging it word for word. | Very scientific. {sci} points, as is.

spanish: El moco ha cambiado de forma. Fascinante. Y un poco asqueroso. | El moco tiene una forma nueva. Increíble. También asqueroso. | El moco ha cambiado de forma en {here}. Fascinante. Y un poco asqueroso.
english: The goo changed shape. Fascinating. And a little gross. | The goo has a new shape. Amazing. Also gross. | The goo changed shape at {here}. Fascinating. And a little gross.

spanish: Anotado. No le pongas nombre. | Anotado. Nada de ponerle nombre al moco. | Anotado, {kerbal}. No le pongas nombre.
english: Noted. Don't give it a name. | Logged. No naming the goo. | Noted, {kerbal}. Don't give it a name.

spanish: El moco se movió cuando no miraba. | El moco se movió mientras miraba a otro lado.
english: The goo moved when I wasn't looking. | The goo shifted while I looked away.

spanish: Normal. Mira siempre, entonces. | Normal. Así que no le quites el ojo.
english: Normal. Then always look. | Normal. So keep your eyes on it.

spanish: Observación del moco: más oscuro que ayer. | Nota del moco: más oscuro que ayer. | Día {day}. Observación del moco: más oscuro que ayer.
english: Goo observation: darker than yesterday. | Goo note: darker than yesterday. | Day {day}. Goo observation: darker than yesterday.

spanish: Anotado. Fotografía el color. | Anotado. Hazle una foto al color.
english: Noted. Photograph the color. | Noted. Take a picture of the color.

spanish: El moco hizo una burbuja. Una sola, pero orgullosa. | El moco hizo una burbuja. Una burbuja orgullosa.
english: The goo made one bubble. Just one, but proud. | The goo made a bubble. A proud one.

spanish: Muy bien. Que siga así. | Bien. Anímalo. | Muy bien. Una burbuja de {sci} puntos.
english: Very good. Let it keep going. | Good. Encourage it. | Very good. A {sci} point bubble.

spanish: He dado las gracias al moco. Parecía contento. | Le di las gracias al moco. Parecía feliz.
english: I thanked the goo. It looked pleased. | I said thanks to the goo. It seemed happy.

spanish: No hables con el moco. Pero gracias. | Por favor, no hables con el moco. Gracias de todos modos.
english: Don't talk to the goo. But thanks. | Please don't talk to the goo. Thanks anyway.

spanish: Este asteroide tiene un agujero. ¿Lo hice yo? | Hay un agujero en este asteroide. ¿Mío?
english: This asteroid has a hole. Did I make it? | There's a hole in this asteroid. Mine?

spanish: Probablemente. Apunta el tamaño.
english: Probably. Note the size.

spanish: El trozo de asteroide es más grande que mi mochila. | El trozo de asteroide es más grande que mi mochila.
english: The asteroid piece is bigger than my pack. | The asteroid chunk is larger than my pack.

spanish: Entonces tira la mochila. | Pues deja la mochila.
english: Then drop the pack. | Then ditch the pack.

spanish: ¿Podemos llamar a este asteroide Pedro? | ¿Podríamos llamar Pedro a este asteroide?
english: Can we call this asteroid Pedro? | Could we name this asteroid Pedro?

spanish: Ya tiene un nombre de catálogo. Pero Pedro suena bien. | Tiene nombre de catálogo. Aunque Pedro suena bien.
english: It has a catalog name. But Pedro sounds good. | It has a catalog name. Pedro sounds nice though.

spanish: El asteroide me mira con sus cráteres. | El asteroide me vigila con sus cráteres.
english: The asteroid stares at me with its craters. | The asteroid watches me with its craters.

spanish: Lo hacen todos. No te asustes. | Lo hacen todos. Calma.
english: They all do. Don't be scared. | They all do. Don't worry.

spanish: Se me ha caído una piedra del asteroide. | Se me ha escapado una piedra de la mano.
english: I dropped a rock from the asteroid. | A rock slipped out of my hand.

spanish: Ve a buscarla. Con calma. | Ve a por ella. Con calma.
english: Go get it. Calmly. | Go fetch it. Calmly.

spanish: Este asteroide es mío. Lo encontré primero. | Yo encontré este asteroide primero. Es mío.
english: This asteroid is mine. I found it first. | I found this asteroid first. It's mine.

spanish: Lo siento, es del programa. | Lo siento, {kerbal}. Es del programa.
english: Sorry, it belongs to the program. | Sorry, {kerbal}. It belongs to the program.

spanish: Trocito de cometa en la bolsa. Está helado. | Trozo de cometa helado, en la bolsa.
english: Comet chip in the bag. It's icy. | Icy comet chip, bagged.

spanish: Recibido. No lo chupes. | Copy. Nada de chupar. | Recibido, {kerbal}. No lo chupes.
english: Copy. Don't lick it. | Copy. No licking. | Copy, {kerbal}. Don't lick it.

spanish: Muestra de cometa lista. Es una bola de hielo sucia. | Muestra de cometa hecha. Una bola de nieve sucia.
english: Comet sample ready. A dirty ice ball. | Comet sample done. A dirty snowball.

spanish: Copy. La más bonita de la galaxia. | Copy. La más bonita de la galaxia. | Copy. {sci} puntos de nieve sucia. La más bonita de la galaxia.
english: Copy. The prettiest in the galaxy. | Copy. Prettiest in the galaxy. | Copy. {sci} points of dirty snow. The prettiest in the galaxy.

spanish: El cometa tiene cola. Y yo también lo seguí. | El cometa tiene cola. La seguí.
english: The comet has a tail. And I followed it. | The comet has a tail. I followed it.

spanish: Es lo normal con los cometas. | Es lo que se hace con los cometas.
english: That's normal with comets. | That's what you do with comets.

spanish: Tomé hielo del cometa. Es hielo, sin duda. | Hielo del cometa. Hielo, seguro.
english: Took ice from the comet. It's definitely ice. | Ice from the comet. Definitely ice.

spanish: Evidente, pero anotado. | Obvio, pero apuntado.
english: Obvious, but noted. | Obvious, but logged.

spanish: El hielo del cometa brilla como una joya. | El hielo del cometa brilla como una gema.
english: The comet's ice glows like a jewel. | Comet ice shines like a gem.

spanish: Es una joya científica. Cuídala. | Una gema científica. Cuídala.
english: It's a scientific jewel. Take care. | A scientific gem. Take care of it.

spanish: Muestra de cometa en el contenedor frío. | La muestra de cometa está en el congelador. | La muestra de cometa está en el contenedor frío de {vessel}.
english: Comet sample in the cold container. | The comet sample is in the freezer. | The comet sample is in the {vessel} cold container.

spanish: Perfecto. Que no se derrita. | Perfecto. Que siga congelada.
english: Perfect. Don't let it melt. | Perfect. Keep it frozen.

spanish: El cometa suelta polvo. Parece nieve de otro mundo. | El cometa va soltando polvo. Como nieve de otro mundo.
english: The comet sheds dust. Looks like snow from another world. | Dust trails off the comet. Like alien snow.

spanish: Atrapa un poco. Con guantes. | Coge un poco. Con guantes.
english: Catch some. With gloves. | Catch some. Use gloves.

spanish: Recogí material del cometa sin accidentes. Casi. | Tengo material del cometa sin incidentes. Casi.
english: Collected comet material without accidents. Almost. | Got comet material without incident. Mostly.

spanish: Casi está permitido. | Casi está bien.
english: Almost is allowed. | Mostly is fine.

spanish: Cometa visitado. Fue una cita breve pero bonita. | He visitado el cometa. Una cita corta y bonita. | Día {day}. Cometa visitado. Fue una cita breve pero bonita.
english: Comet visited. A short but nice date. | Visited the comet. A short, nice date. | Day {day}. Comet visited. A short but nice date.

spanish: Bien. Que no se entere nadie. | Bien. Que quede entre nosotros.
english: Good. Don't tell anyone. | Good. Keep it quiet.

spanish: El cometa cambia mientras lo miro. Qué prisa tiene. | El cometa cambia mientras lo miro. Tiene prisa.
english: The comet changes while I look. What a hurry. | The comet is changing as I watch. In a rush.

spanish: Apúntate rápido, entonces. | Pues toma notas deprisa.
english: Take notes fast, then. | Take notes quickly, then.

spanish: Guardé el hielo del cometa junto al sándwich. | El hielo del cometa está al lado de mi sándwich.
english: I stored the comet ice next to my sandwich. | Comet ice is now beside my sandwich.

spanish: Separa las dos cosas. Por favor. | Sepáralos, por favor.
english: Separate the two. Please. | Please separate them.

spanish: Muestra de cometa tomada. Hielo, polvo y misterio. | Muestra de cometa: hielo, polvo, misterio.
english: Comet sample taken. Ice, dust and mystery. | Comet sample: ice, dust, mystery.

spanish: Perfecto. Guárdala lejos de la calefacción. | Genial. Lejos de la calefacción. | Perfecto. {sci} puntos. Guárdala lejos de la calefacción.
english: Perfect. Keep it away from the heater. | Great. Not near the heater. | Perfect. {sci} points. Keep it away from the heater.

spanish: Control, el cometa me está llorando encima. | Control, el cometa gotea encima de mí.
english: Control, the comet is crying on me. | Control, the comet is dripping on me.

spanish: Es hielo derritiéndose. No llora. | Solo es hielo derretido. No son lágrimas.
english: It's melting ice. It's not crying. | Just melting ice. Not tears.

spanish: El cometa huele a pies.
english: The comet smells like feet.

spanish: Interesante. Podemos llamarlo cometa-pie. | Interesante. Cometa-pie, entonces.
english: Interesting. We could call it a foot comet. | Interesting. A foot comet it is.

spanish: Tengo una cola de cometa en el casco. | Tengo cola de cometa pegada en el visor.
english: There's some comet tail on my helmet. | Some comet tail is stuck on my visor.

spanish: Límpiala. Es polvo valioso. | Quítala. Es polvo valioso.
english: Wipe it. It's valuable dust. | Wipe it off. Valuable dust.

spanish: El cometa pasa cada mucho tiempo. No quiero perdérmelo. | El cometa es raro de ver. No quiero perdérmelo.
english: The comet comes by once in ages. I don't want to miss it. | The comet is rare. I don't want to miss it.

spanish: No te lo pierdas. Tómate la muestra. | No te lo pierdas. Coge la muestra.
english: Don't miss it. Take your sample. | Don't miss it. Take the sample.

spanish: La muestra de cometa se me escapa de las manos. | La muestra de cometa se me escurre entre los dedos.
english: The comet sample keeps slipping out of my hands. | The comet sample slips through my fingers.

spanish: ¡Al contenedor! Rápido. | ¡Al contenedor! Deprisa.
english: Into the container! Quick. | Into the container! Hurry.

spanish: Este cometa tiene mal carácter. Me dio un golpe de polvo. | Este cometa tiene mala actitud. Polvo en la cara.
english: This comet has a temper. It hit me with dust. | The comet has a bad attitude. Dust in the face.

spanish: Los cometas son así. Sigue trabajando. | Los cometas son así. Sigue.
english: Comets are like that. Keep working. | Comets are like that. Carry on.

spanish: ¿Los cometas también viajan por trabajo? | ¿Los cometas también viajan por negocios?
english: Do comets travel for work too? | Do comets also travel for business?

spanish: Sí, y nunca cobran. | Sí, y nunca les pagan.
english: Yes, and never get paid. | Yes, and they never get paid.

spanish: Mi bolsa de muestra está llena de hielo. | Mi bolsa de muestras es todo hielo.
english: My sample bag is full of ice. | My sample bag is all ice.

spanish: Es lo que queríamos. Cierra bien. | Justo lo que queríamos. Ciérrala.
english: That's what we wanted. Close it well. | Exactly what we wanted. Seal it.

spanish: El cometa brilla más que yo. | El cometa brilla más que yo.
english: The comet shines brighter than me. | The comet outshines me.

spanish: Todos brillamos distinto. Ánimo. | Cada uno brilla a su manera. | Todos brillamos distinto, {kerbal}. Ánimo.
english: We all shine differently. Cheer up. | Everyone shines in a different way. | We all shine differently, {kerbal}. Cheer up.

spanish: Quiero un cometa para mi cumpleaños. | Un cometa sería un buen regalo de cumpleaños.
english: I want a comet for my birthday. | A comet would be a nice birthday present.

spanish: Te daremos una muestra. Es lo más cercano. | Te mandaremos una muestra. Es lo más parecido.
english: We'll give you a sample. Closest thing. | We'll send a sample. That's as close as it gets.

spanish: El telescopio ve cosas que mis ojos no ven. | El telescopio ve más que yo. | El telescopio ve cosas de {here} que mis ojos no ven.
english: The telescope sees things my eyes can't. | The telescope sees more than I do. | The telescope sees things around {here} my eyes can't.

spanish: Recibido. Para eso lo pagamos. | Copy. Por eso lo compramos. | Recibido. {sci} puntos. Para eso lo pagamos.
english: Copy. That's what we paid for. | Copy. That's why we bought it. | Copy. {sci} points. That's what we paid for.

spanish: El telescopio apunta a algo brillante. No sé qué. | El telescopio ha encontrado algo brillante. No sé qué es.
english: The telescope points at something bright. No idea what. | The telescope found something bright. Not sure what.

spanish: Copy. Anota las coordenadas. | Copy. Apunta las coordenadas.
english: Copy. Write down the coordinates. | Copy. Note the coordinates.

spanish: Vi una estrella nueva. Quizá la inventé. | Una estrella nueva. O me la he imaginado.
english: I saw a new star. Maybe I invented it. | A new star. Or I imagined it.

spanish: Compruébalo. Las estrellas no se inventan. | Compruébalo. Las estrellas no se pueden inventar. | Compruébalo, {kerbal}. Las estrellas no se inventan.
english: Check it. Stars aren't invented. | Check it. Stars can't be invented. | Check it, {kerbal}. Stars aren't invented.

spanish: El telescopio infrarrojo ve el calor de todo. Incluso el mío. | El infrarrojo ve el calor de todos. El mío también.
english: The infrared telescope sees the heat of everything. Even mine. | Infrared sees everyone's warmth. Mine too.

spanish: Es lo que hace. No te tapes. | Es su trabajo. No te escondas.
english: That's what it does. Don't cover up. | That's its job. Don't hide.

spanish: Imagen capturada. Tiene muchos puntos. | Imagen tomada. Un montón de puntos. | Imagen capturada sobre {here}. Tiene muchos puntos.
english: Image captured. Lots of dots. | Image captured. Plenty of dots. | Image captured over {here}. Lots of dots.

spanish: Perfecto. Cada punto es un dato. | Perfecto. Cada punto es un dato. Y suman {sci} puntos.
english: Perfect. Each dot is data. | Perfect. Each dot is data. And they add up to {sci} points.

spanish: El telescopio está enfocado. Todo se ve nítido. | Telescopio enfocado. Todo nítido.
english: The telescope is focused. Everything looks sharp. | Telescope focused. It's all sharp.

spanish: Eso es raro. Normalmente sale borroso. | Qué raro. Suele salir borroso.
english: That's unusual. Usually it's blurry. | Rare. It's usually blurry.

spanish: Datos infrarrojos listos. Hay colores que no existen. | Datos infrarrojos listos. Colores que no son reales.
english: Infrared data ready. Colors that don't exist. | Infrared data in. Colors that aren't real.

spanish: Son falsos pero útiles. | Falsos, pero útiles.
english: False but useful. | Fake, but useful.

spanish: Telescopio calibrado. Casi sin tocar el espejo. | Telescopio calibrado. Apenas toqué el espejo.
english: Telescope calibrated. Barely touched the mirror. | Telescope calibrated. Hardly touched the mirror.

spanish: Nunca toques el espejo.
english: Never touch the mirror.

spanish: Observé una galaxia lejana. Parecía una mancha. | Una galaxia lejana. Parece una mancha.
english: Observed a distant galaxy. It looked like a smudge. | A far galaxy. Looks like a smudge.

spanish: Todas las galaxias parecen manchas de lejos. | De lejos, toda galaxia es una mancha.
english: Galaxies all look like smudges from afar. | From far, every galaxy is a smudge.

spanish: El telescopio vio un puntito rojo. Era una luz del panel. | Un punto rojo. Al final era una luz del panel. | El telescopio vio un puntito rojo. Era una luz del panel de {vessel}.
english: The telescope saw a red dot. It was a panel light. | A red dot. Turned out to be a panel light. | The telescope saw a red dot. It was a light on the {vessel} panel.

spanish: Eso pasa. Anota el error. | Pasa. Apunta el error.
english: Happens. Note the mistake. | Happens. Log the mistake.

spanish: Mirando por el telescopio se me cansa un ojo. | Con el telescopio se me cansa un ojo.
english: Looking through the telescope tires one eye. | One eye gets tired from the telescope.

spanish: Cambia de ojo. Es el truco. | Cambia de ojo. Truco viejo.
english: Switch eyes. That's the trick. | Switch eyes. Old trick.

spanish: Miro por el telescopio. Veo estrellas. Muchas. | Vista del telescopio: estrellas. Muchísimas estrellas. | Miro por el telescopio a {alt_km} kilómetros. Veo estrellas. Muchas.
english: Looking through the telescope. I see stars. Lots. | Telescope view: stars. So many stars. | Looking through the telescope at {alt_km} km up. I see stars. Lots.

spanish: Anotado. Cuéntalas más tarde. | Tenemos los datos. Cuenta luego.
english: Noted. Count them later. | Got the data. Count later.

spanish: Control, el telescopio ve algo que me mira. | Control, algo del telescopio me devuelve la mirada.
english: Control, the telescope sees something that's looking at me. | Control, something in the telescope is looking back.

spanish: Es un reflejo. Todos parecen mirarte. | Un reflejo. Todos te miran.
english: It's a reflection. They all seem to stare. | A reflection. They all look at you.

spanish: Hay tanto que ver que no sé dónde mirar. | Cuánto que mirar. ¿Por dónde empiezo?
english: There's so much to see I don't know where to look. | So much to look at. Where do I begin?

spanish: Mira cualquier cosa. Todo vale. | Lo que sea. Todo cuenta. | Mira cualquier cosa. Mira {next}, por ejemplo.
english: Look at anything. It all counts. | Pick anything. It all counts. | Look at anything. Look at {next}, for example.

spanish: El telescopio se empañó. | El telescopio se ha empañado entero.
english: The telescope fogged up. | The telescope has fogged over.

spanish: Límpialo con tu manga. Con cuidado. | Límpialo con la manga. Suave.
english: Wipe it with your sleeve. Carefully. | Wipe it with your sleeve. Gently.

spanish: Vi un cometa. O era una mosca en el cristal. | Un cometa. O una mosca en la lente.
english: I saw a comet. Or a fly on the glass. | A comet. Or a fly on the lens.

spanish: Seguro que era una mosca. Probablemente. | Lo más seguro, una mosca. Probablemente.
english: Surely a fly. Probably. | Most likely a fly. Probably.

spanish: ¿Cuántos puntos hay? Perdí la cuenta. | ¿Cuántos puntos? He perdido la cuenta.
english: How many dots are there? I lost count. | How many dots? I lost count.

spanish: Muchos. Anota la cuenta hasta donde llegaste. | Muchos. Apunta dónde paraste.
english: Many. Write down where you got to. | Plenty. Note where you stopped.

spanish: El telescopio apunta al revés. | El telescopio está mirando hacia atrás.
english: The telescope points the wrong way. | The telescope is pointing backwards.

spanish: Dale la vuelta. Y apunta al objetivo. | Gíralo. Apunta al objetivo.
english: Turn it. Point at the target. | Turn it around. Aim at the target.

spanish: Esta imagen es muy borrosa. Se parece a mi ojo. | La imagen está borrosa. Mi ojo también.
english: This image is very blurry. Like my eye. | The image is blurry. So is my eye.

spanish: Prueba con el enfoque. | Prueba con la rueda del enfoque.
english: Try the focus. | Try the focus knob.

spanish: El telescopio es más grande que yo. | El telescopio es enorme a mi lado.
english: The telescope is bigger than me. | The telescope towers over me.

spanish: Por eso ve más lejos.
english: That's why it sees farther.

spanish: Vi una estrella con forma de patata. | Hay una estrella con forma de patata.
english: I saw a potato-shaped star. | There's a star shaped like a potato.

spanish: Las estrellas son redondas. Mira otra vez.
english: Stars are round. Look again.

spanish: Mi telescopio me ve a mí en el reflejo. | Me veo en el telescopio.
english: My telescope sees me in the reflection. | I see myself in the telescope.

spanish: Muy bien. Ahora mira hacia el otro lado.
english: Good. Now look the other way.

spanish: El magnetómetro se ha vuelto loco. La brújula también. | El magnetómetro está desatado. La brújula también. | El magnetómetro se ha vuelto loco sobre {here}. La brújula también.
english: The magnetometer went crazy. The compass too. | Magnetometer is going wild. The compass too. | The magnetometer went crazy over {here}. The compass too.

spanish: Normal. Ahí arriba el norte es una opinión. | Normal. Allí arriba el norte es una sugerencia.
english: Normal. Up there north is just an opinion. | Normal. North is a suggestion up there.

spanish: El magnetómetro mide el campo magnético. Me siento atraído. | Lectura del magnetómetro lista. Siento que me atrae.
english: The magnetometer reads the field. I feel attracted. | Magnetometer reading in. I feel pulled.

spanish: Eso es el hierro de la sangre. | Eso es el hierro de la sangre, {kerbal}.
english: That's the iron in your blood. | That's the iron in your blood, {kerbal}.

spanish: El imán de la nave hace trampas. | El imán de la propia nave hace trampas. | El imán de {vessel} hace trampas.
english: The ship's magnet is cheating. | The ship's own magnet is cheating. | The {vessel} magnet is cheating.

spanish: Anótalo. Y réstalo después. | Apúntalo. Réstalo luego.
english: Note it. And subtract it later. | Write it down. Subtract it later.

spanish: El campo magnético es raro. No lo veo, pero lo noto. | El campo magnético es extraño. No se ve, pero se siente. | A {alt_km} kilómetros el campo magnético es raro. No lo veo, pero lo noto.
english: The magnetic field is odd. I can't see it, but I notice it. | The magnetic field is strange. Unseen, but felt. | At {alt_km} km the magnetic field is odd. I can't see it, but I notice it.

spanish: Los campos raros también importan.
english: Odd fields matter too.

spanish: Brújula loca. Magnetómetro tranquilo. | La brújula se ha vuelto loca. El magnetómetro, tranquilo.
english: Compass crazy. Magnetometer calm. | The compass is going wild. The magnetometer is calm.

spanish: Confiamos en el magnetómetro. | Confiamos en el magnetómetro. Vale {sci} puntos.
english: We trust the magnetometer. | We trust the magnetometer. It's worth {sci} points.

spanish: Lectura magnética lista. La aguja bailó un poco. | Lectura magnética hecha. La aguja bailó un poquito.
english: Magnetic reading ready. The needle danced a bit. | Magnetic reading done. The needle had a little dance.

spanish: Que baile. Pero que escriba números. | Que baile. Pero que dé números.
english: Let it dance. But have it write numbers. | Let it dance. Just get numbers.

spanish: El magnetómetro dice norte. Mi estómago dice sur. | Magnetómetro: norte. Estómago: sur.
english: The magnetometer says north. My stomach says south. | Magnetometer: north. Stomach: south.

spanish: Hazle caso al magnetómetro. | Quédate con el magnetómetro.
english: Listen to the magnetometer. | Go with the magnetometer.

spanish: Mi reloj se volvió loco con el campo magnético. | Mi reloj ha perdido la cabeza cerca del campo magnético.
english: My watch went crazy near the field. | My watch lost it near the magnetic field.

spanish: Eso pasa. Pregúntale la hora luego. | Pasa. Pregúntale la hora más tarde.
english: That happens. Ask it the time later. | Happens. Ask it the time later.

spanish: Magnetómetro activo. Las llaves no están seguras. | Magnetómetro activo. Las llaves, lejos.
english: Magnetometer on. The keys aren't safe. | Magnetometer active. Keep the keys away.

spanish: Guárdalas lejos. Muy lejos. | Guárdalas bien lejos.
english: Keep them away. Far away. | Stow them far away.

spanish: Campo magnético medido. Es invisible pero feo. | Campo medido. Invisible y desagradable.
english: Magnetic field measured. Invisible but ugly. | Field measured. Invisible, and unpleasant.

spanish: Ni lo ves ni lo juzgues. Mídelo. | No lo juzgues. Solo mídelo.
english: Don't see it or judge it. Measure it. | Don't judge it. Just measure.

spanish: El magnetómetro funciona. Mi pelo también reacciona. | El magnetómetro funciona. Mi pelo también.
english: The magnetometer works. My hair reacts too. | The magnetometer works. My hair does too.

spanish: Entonces tu pelo es un sensor. | Entonces tu pelo es un sensor.
english: Then your hair is a sensor. | Your hair is a sensor, then.

spanish: Campo magnético medido. Es más fuerte de lo esperado. | Campo magnético fuerte. Más de lo que pensábamos. | Campo magnético de {here} medido. Es más fuerte de lo esperado.
english: Magnetic field measured. Stronger than expected. | Strong magnetic field. Stronger than we thought. | The magnetic field of {here} measured. Stronger than expected.

spanish: Recibido. Que nadie acerque la caja de herramientas. | Copy. La caja de herramientas, lejos.
english: Copy. Keep the toolbox away from it. | Copy. Toolbox stays away.

spanish: Control, el magnetómetro cambia de número sin parar. | Control, la lectura del magnetómetro no para de saltar.
english: Control, the magnetometer keeps changing its number. | Control, the magnetometer reading keeps jumping.

spanish: Es normal. Quédate quieto un momento. | Normal. Quédate quieto un momento.
english: Normal. Hold still a moment. | Normal. Stay still for a moment.

spanish: Siento que algo tira de mi traje. | Noto que algo tira de mi traje.
english: Something is tugging at my suit. | I feel something pulling on my suit.

spanish: Es el campo magnético. O un compañero. | El campo. O un compañero.
english: The magnetic field. Or a coworker. | The field. Or a coworker.

spanish: El magnetómetro salta como loco. | El magnetómetro va dando saltos.
english: The magnetometer jumps wildly. | The magnetometer is jumping around.

spanish: Déjalo. Se cansará. | Déjalo. Se calmará.
english: Leave it. It'll tire out. | Leave it. It'll settle.

spanish: Mi imán de nevera dejó de funcionar. | Mi imán de nevera se ha rendido.
english: My fridge magnet stopped working. | My fridge magnet gave up.

spanish: Tu imán no era tan fuerte. | Tu imán era flojo.
english: Your magnet wasn't that strong. | Your magnet was weak.

spanish: ¿Se pueden atraer los kerbals? | ¿Los kerbals pueden ser magnéticos? | Somos {crew}. ¿Se pueden atraer los kerbals?
english: Can kerbals attract each other? | Can kerbals be magnetic? | There are {crew} of us. Can kerbals attract each other?

spanish: Los kerbals sí, pero por simpatía. | Sí, pero solo por simpatía.
english: Kerbals, yes, but through charm. | Yes, through charm only.

spanish: El campo magnético me hace cosquillas en el traje. | El campo magnético le hace cosquillas a mi traje.
english: The magnetic field tickles my suit. | The magnetic field is tickling my suit.

spanish: Despégate con calma. | Despégate despacio.
english: Peel yourself off calmly. | Peel off slowly.

spanish: El magnetómetro tiene un nombre muy largo. | Qué nombre más largo para un aparato.

spanish: La roca es rara. No sé por qué. | Esta roca me da una sensación rara. No sé por qué.

spanish: Probablemente no. Pero tráela. | Seguramente no. Tráela igual.
english: Probably not. But bring it. | Probably not. Bring it anyway.

spanish: La roca tiene manchas. Manchas grises. | La roca tiene manchas grises.
english: The rock has spots. Gray spots. | There are gray spots on the rock.

spanish: Anota eso. Eso sí es raro. | Apúntalo. Es raro.
english: Write that down. That's strange. | Log that. That's odd.

spanish: Roca estudiada. Es dura. Muy dura. | He estudiado la roca. Dura. Muy dura.
english: Rock studied. It's hard. Very hard. | Studied the rock. Hard. Very hard.

spanish: Gracias por el dato técnico. | Gracias por el dato técnico. {sci} puntos por dura.
english: Thanks for the technical detail. | Thanks for the technical detail. {sci} points for hard.

spanish: He rodeado la roca tres veces. Es grande. | Tres vueltas a la roca. Es grande.
english: I walked around the rock three times. It's big. | Three laps around the rock. It's big.

spanish: Sí. Las rocas suelen serlo. | Sí. Las rocas tienden a serlo.
english: Yes. Rocks usually are. | Yes. Rocks tend to be.

spanish: La roca parece un animal. Un animal muy quieto. | La roca parece un animal muy quieto.
english: The rock looks like an animal. A very still one. | The rock resembles a very still animal.

spanish: Fotografía al animal. Con su permiso. | Hazle una foto. Con permiso.

spanish: He apuntado la roca en el mapa. Ya es famosa. | La roca ya está en el mapa. Ahora es famosa. | He apuntado la roca de {biome} en el mapa. Ya es famosa.
english: I marked the rock on the map. It's famous now. | The rock is on the map. Now famous. | I marked the {biome} rock on the map. It's famous now.

spanish: Qué orgullo. Que no se le suba. | Orgullosos. Ojalá siga humilde.
english: How proud. Hope it stays humble. | Proud of it. Hope it stays humble.

spanish: Aquí hay una roca con forma rara. Parece una cara. | Una roca rara aquí. Tiene cara. | Aquí en {biome} hay una roca con forma rara. Parece una cara.
english: There's an oddly shaped rock here. It looks like a face. | Weird rock here. It has a face. | There's an oddly shaped rock here in {biome}. It looks like a face.

spanish: Anotado. Hazle una foto de perfil. | Apuntado. Sácale su lado bueno.
english: Noted. Take a profile shot. | Logged. Get its good side.

spanish: Control, esta roca es muy rara. | Control, esta roca es extraña.
english: Control, this rock is very strange. | Control, this rock is odd.

spanish: Describe rara con detalles. | Danos detalles de lo extraño.
english: Describe strange with details. | Give us details on strange.

spanish: La roca tiene forma de una cara sonriente. | La roca parece una carita feliz.
english: The rock is shaped like a smiling face. | The rock looks like a smiley.

spanish: Una cara simpática. Anótala. | Una cara amable. Apúntala.
english: A friendly face. Note it. | A friendly face. Log it.

spanish: Esta roca se parece a mi suegra. | Esta roca me recuerda a mi suegra.
english: This rock looks like my mother-in-law. | This rock reminds me of my mother-in-law.

spanish: Mejor no lo apuntes. | Mejor no lo apuntes.
english: Better not write that. | Better not log that.

spanish: La roca no se mueve. Intenté empujarla. | He intentado empujar la roca. No se mueve.
english: The rock won't move. I tried pushing it. | I tried pushing the rock. It stays.

spanish: Es una roca. Es su trabajo. | Es lo que hacen las rocas.
english: It's a rock. That's its job. | That's what rocks do.

spanish: Hay una roca que parece un sombrero. | Una roca que parece un sombrero.
english: One rock looks like a hat. | A rock that resembles a hat.

spanish: Pruébatelo. Con el casco puesto. | Pruébatelo. Sin quitarte el casco.
english: Try it on. Helmet on. | Try it on. Keep the helmet.

spanish: Me senté en la roca y se rompió. | La roca se rompió cuando me senté.
english: I sat on the rock and it broke. | The rock broke when I sat down.

spanish: Buen dato. Era una roca frágil. | Útil. Una roca frágil.
english: Good data. It was a fragile rock. | Useful. A fragile rock.

spanish: La roca tiene una sombra rara. | La roca da una sombra extraña.
english: The rock has an odd shadow. | The rock casts a strange shadow.

spanish: Es una sombra. Mídela. | Una sombra. Mídela.
english: It's a shadow. Measure it. | A shadow. Measure it.

spanish: Encontré dos rocas iguales. Son gemelas. | Dos rocas iguales. Gemelas. | Encontré dos rocas iguales en {biome}. Son gemelas.
english: I found two identical rocks. Twins. | Two matching rocks. Twins. | I found two identical rocks in {biome}. Twins.

spanish: Anótalas como par. Y no las separes. | Apúntalas como pareja. Juntas.
english: Log them as a pair. Don't separate them. | Log them as a pair. Keep them together.

spanish: La roca está cubierta de polvo. | La roca está llena de polvo.
english: The rock is covered in dust. | The rock is all dusty.

spanish: Cepíllala. Con suavidad. | Quítale el polvo. Con suavidad.
english: Brush it. Gently. | Brush it off. Gently.

spanish: He bautizado la roca. Se llama Roca. | Le he puesto nombre a la roca. Se llama Roca.
english: I named the rock. Its name is Rock. | I named the rock. It's called Rock.

spanish: Original. Muy científico.
english: Original. Very scientific.

spanish: ¡Ciencia conseguida! | ¡Tenemos ciencia! | ¡Datos de {exp} conseguidos!
english: Science acquired! | We have science! | {exp} data acquired!

spanish: Bien hecho. Apuntadlo todo. | Bien. Apuntadlo todo. | Bien hecho. Son {sci} puntos. Apuntadlo todo.
english: Well done. Write it all down. | Nice. Write everything down. | Well done. That's {sci} points. Write it all down.

spanish: Control, apunta esto. Es importante. | Control, toma notas. Es importante. | Control, apunta esto. {exp} desde {here}. Es importante.
english: Control, write this down. It's important. | Control, take notes. Important stuff. | Control, write this down. {exp} from {here}. It's important.

spanish: Apuntado. Bueno, casi todo. | Anotado. Casi todo.
english: Written down. Well, most of it. | Noted. Mostly.

english: New data on the way. Freshly made. | Fresh data coming down. | New {exp} data on the way. Freshly made.

spanish: Recibidos. Los científicos ya aplauden. | Recibidos. El laboratorio aplaude.

english: First-rate science. That's worth a medal. | Science in. Medal-worthy. | {sci} science points. That's worth a medal.

spanish: ¿De chocolate? | ¿Medalla de chocolate?

spanish: Ciencia hecha. ¿Hay puntos extra? | Ciencia completa. ¿Puntos extra?
english: Science done. Do we get bonus points? | Science complete. Bonus points?

english: There are points. And more work. | Points, yes. Also more work. | There are {sci} points. And more work.

spanish: Ya salen los números. Creo que bien. | Llegan los números. Buenos, creo.

english: Sighs count too. | Noted. Don't jump, you'll confuse it.

spanish: Sismómetro en {biome}. Escuchando. | Control, el suelo de {biome} está hablando.
english: Seismometer in {biome}. Listening. | Control, the ground of {biome} is talking.

english: And what does it say? | Good. Note everything it says.

spanish: Datos nuevos. {sci} puntos. | Bien. Ahora sabemos cuánto pesa una montaña.

english: The gravity here is the same. | Control, {grav_g} g again. Like before.

english: Gravity of {grav_g} g. I weigh almost nothing. | Control, here I could jump to the ship.

english: Don't jump. We mean it. | Noted. Hold on to something.

english: Gravity of {grav_g} g. Everything is heavy here. | Control, this gravity pulls me down. Hard.

english: Gravity scan of Kerbin. {grav_g} g. | Control, home gravity. Still working.

english: Good thing. It keeps us all on the ground. | Copy. Thanks for checking.

english: The first air analysis of {here}. Nobody had smelled it. | Control, the air of {here} is new to us.

spanish: Un aire histórico. {sci} puntos. | Bien. Pero no lo huelas tú.
english: Historic air. {sci} points. | Good. But don't you smell it.

spanish: El mismo aire que antes. | Control, otro análisis del aire de {here}. Igual.
english: Same air as before. | Control, another air analysis of {here}. Same.

spanish: Ya tenemos ese aire en un frasco. Prueba otro. | Gracias. Este aire ya lo conocemos.
english: We have that air in a jar already. Try another. | Thanks. We know this air.

spanish: Aire muy denso. {press_kpa} kilopascales. Casi se puede masticar. | Control, este aire pesa más que yo.
english: Very thick air. {press_kpa} kilopascals. You could almost chew it. | Control, this air weighs more than me.

spanish: No lo mastiques. Anotado. | Interesante. Y un poco preocupante.
english: Don't chew it. Noted. | Interesting. And a bit worrying.

spanish: Aire muy fino. Casi no hay nada que analizar. | Control, aquí hay poco aire. Lo he analizado igual.
english: Very thin air. Almost nothing to analyze. | Control, there's little air here. I analyzed it anyway.

spanish: Poco aire también es un dato. | Recibido. Respira del tanque, no de fuera.
english: Thin air is data too. | Copy. Breathe from the tank, not from outside.

spanish: Análisis del aire de casa. Huele a Kerbin. | Control, el aire de Kerbin. Sigue siendo respirable.
english: Analysis of home air. Smells like Kerbin. | Control, Kerbin air. Still breathable.

spanish: Menos mal. Lo usamos todos. | Recibido. Gracias por vigilarlo.
english: Good thing. We all use it. | Copy. Thanks for keeping an eye on it.

english: The first piece of this asteroid. Nobody had touched it. | Control, a new asteroid sample. Very new. And very old.

spanish: Una roca histórica. {sci} puntos. | Perfecto. Guárdala como un tesoro.
english: A historic rock. {sci} points. | Perfect. Keep it like treasure.

spanish: Un asteroide lejos de casa, cerca de {here}. Muestra tomada. | Control, roca espacial de los alrededores de {here}.
english: An asteroid far from home, near {here}. Sample taken. | Control, a space rock from around {here}.

spanish: Tráela de vuelta. Es un viaje largo para una piedra. | Anotado. Los geólogos están impacientes.
english: Bring it back. A long trip for a rock. | Noted. The geologists are impatient.

spanish: Muestra de asteroide, casi en casa. | Control, un asteroide que vino a visitar Kerbin.
english: Asteroid sample, nearly at home. | Control, an asteroid that came to visit Kerbin.

spanish: Muy amable por su parte. | Recibido. Un buen vecino, mientras no se acerque más.

english: Another asteroid sample. That's {exp_runs}. | Control, more asteroid. I'm taking it apart.

spanish: Deja algo de asteroide para los demás. | Recibido. Cuidado, no lo rompas entero.
english: Leave some asteroid for the others. | Copy. Careful, don't break the whole thing.

spanish: Primera muestra de este cometa. Hielo que nadie había visto. | Control, tengo un trozo de cometa nuevo.
english: The first sample of this comet. Ice nobody had seen. | Control, I have a piece of a new comet.

spanish: Un hielo histórico. {sci} puntos. Que no se derrita. | Bien. Guárdalo en el frío.
english: Historic ice. {sci} points. Don't let it melt. | Good. Keep it cold.

spanish: Muestra de cometa cerca de {here}. Muy lejos de casa. | Control, este cometa viaja más que nosotros.
english: Comet sample near {here}. Far from home. | Control, this comet travels more than we do.

spanish: Y sin billete. Tráela. | Recibido. Gran viaje para un poco de hielo.
english: And without a ticket. Bring it. | Copy. A long trip for a bit of ice.

spanish: Más hielo de cometa. Van {exp_runs} muestras. | Control, el contenedor frío se está llenando.
english: More comet ice. That's {exp_runs} samples. | Control, the cold container is filling up.

spanish: Perfecto. Hielo de sobra para el laboratorio. | Recibido. Cierra bien la tapa.
english: Perfect. Plenty of ice for the lab. | Copy. Close the lid well.

spanish: Primeras imágenes infrarrojas desde aquí. Cosas nuevas. | Control, el telescopio ve algo que nadie había visto.
english: First infrared images from here. New things. | Control, the telescope sees something nobody has seen.

spanish: Imágenes históricas. {sci} puntos. | Perfecto. Guarda una para la pared.
english: Historic images. {sci} points. | Perfect. Keep one for the wall.

english: Telescope running near {here}. The stars look different. | Control, from {here} the sky is different.

spanish: Las mismas estrellas, otro ángulo. Anotado. | Qué envidia. Aquí hay nubes.
english: Same stars, another angle. Noted. | So jealous. It's cloudy here.

spanish: Telescopio a {alt_km} kilómetros. Sin aire delante. | Control, aquí arriba el telescopio lo ve todo nítido.
english: Telescope at {alt_km} km. No air in the way. | Control, up here the telescope sees everything sharp.

spanish: Para eso lo subimos. Buen trabajo. | Recibido. Nada de mirar a la nave.
english: That's why we sent it up. Good work. | Copy. No looking at the ship.

spanish: El mismo cielo que antes. | Control, otra imagen igual. Las estrellas no se mueven.
english: The same sky as before. | Control, another identical image. The stars don't move.

spanish: Ya tenemos esta vista. Apunta a otro sitio. | Gracias. Prueba desde otra órbita.
english: We have this view. Point it elsewhere. | Thanks. Try from another orbit.

spanish: Primer campo magnético medido en {here}. | Control, nadie había medido el campo aquí.
english: The first magnetic field measured at {here}. | Control, nobody measured the field here before.

spanish: Datos nuevos. {sci} puntos. | Bien. Las brújulas del mundo te lo agradecen.
english: New data. {sci} points. | Good. The world's compasses thank you.

english: The magnetic field is the same. | Control, same field, same needle.

english: Weak is data too. | Noted. Go a bit lower next time.

english: The field of {here} is nothing like Kerbin's. | Control, {here} has its own north.

spanish: Interesante. No sigas a la brújula. | Anotado. Que nadie se pierda.
english: Interesting. Don't follow the compass. | Noted. Nobody get lost.

spanish: Primera roca de este tipo en {biome}. | Control, esta formación es nueva para nosotros.
english: The first rock of this kind in {biome}. | Control, this formation is new to us.

spanish: Un hallazgo. {sci} puntos. Hazle muchas fotos. | Perfecto. Los geólogos ya la quieren bautizar.
english: A find. {sci} points. Take lots of photos. | Perfect. The geologists want to name it already.

spanish: Una roca rara en {here}. Nada como en casa. | Control, {here} tiene rocas que no conocemos.
english: An odd rock on {here}. Nothing like home. | Control, {here} has rocks we don't know.

english: Study it well. It may be unique. | Noted. Don't forget where it is.

english: Another curious rock. That's {exp_runs} this flight. | Control, {here} is full of odd rocks.
