english: Crew report, day {day}. Still sane. Mostly. | Control, day {day}. The crew talks to the plants.

spanish: Casi es suficiente. Aguantad. | No tenemos plantas a bordo. Interesante.
english: Mostly is enough. Hang in there. | We have no plants aboard. Interesting.

spanish: Informe de tripulación desde {here}. Echamos de menos Kerbin. | Control, informe desde muy lejos. Todos bien.
english: Crew report from {here}. We miss Kerbin. | Control, a report from far away. All fine.

spanish: Kerbin también os echa de menos. | Recibido. La distancia se nota en la voz.
english: Kerbin misses you too. | Copy. The distance shows in your voice.

spanish: Mis primeros pasos fuera en {here}. Informe hecho. | Control, nunca había salido aquí. {biome} me saluda.
english: My first steps outside on {here}. Report done. | Control, I'd never gone out here. {biome} says hello.

spanish: Un momento para recordar, {kerbal}. | Disfrútalo. Pero sin alejarte.
english: A moment to remember, {kerbal}. | Enjoy it. But stay close.

spanish: Informe desde fuera. Estoy colgado de la nave en pleno vuelo. | Control, informe exterior con mucho viento.
english: EVA report. I'm hanging off the ship in flight. | Control, exterior report with lots of wind.

spanish: ¿Qué haces ahí? Agárrate fuerte. | Recibido. Vuelve dentro. Ya.
english: What are you doing out there? Hold on tight. | Copy. Get back inside. Now.

spanish: Informe desde fuera, a {ship_m} metros de la nave. | Control, me he alejado un poco. {ship_m} metros.
english: EVA report, {ship_m} meters from the ship. | Control, I wandered off a bit. {ship_m} meters.

spanish: Eso es más que un poco. Vuelve despacio. | Recibido. No pierdas de vista {vessel}.
english: That's more than a bit. Come back slowly. | Copy. Keep {vessel} in sight.

spanish: El moco flota dentro del bote. A {alt_km} kilómetros. | Control, en órbita el moco se pone redondo.
english: The goo floats inside the canister. At {alt_km} km. | Control, in orbit the goo goes round.

spanish: Un moco redondo. Eso es nuevo. | Anotado. Fotografía la bola.
english: A round goo. That's new. | Noted. Photograph the ball.

spanish: Moco expuesto en {biome}. Se ha pegado al fondo. | Control, el moco ha probado el suelo de {here}.
english: Goo exposed in {biome}. It stuck to the bottom. | Control, the goo has tasted the ground of {here}.

spanish: ¿Y le ha gustado? | Anotado. No lo dejes salir del bote.
english: And did it like it? | Noted. Don't let it out of the canister.

spanish: Hace {temp_c} grados. El moco está congelado. | Control, el moco no se mueve. Creo que tiene frío.
english: It's {temp_c} degrees. The goo is frozen. | Control, the goo won't move. I think it's cold.

spanish: Un moco helado también es dato. | No le pongas tu bufanda.
english: Frozen goo is data too. | Don't give it your scarf.

spanish: Mi primera muestra de {here}. El primer puñado. | Control, nunca había pisado {here}. Ya tengo tierra.
english: My first sample of {here}. The first handful. | Control, I'd never set foot on {here}. I've got soil already.

spanish: Un recuerdo perfecto, {kerbal}. | Guárdala bien. Es tu primera de {here}.
english: A perfect souvenir, {kerbal}. | Keep it safe. It's your first from {here}.

spanish: Muestra tomada. Aquí cuesta hasta agacharse. | Control, con {grav_g} ge la bolsa pesa el doble.
english: Sample taken. Even bending down is hard here. | Control, at {grav_g} g the bag weighs double.

spanish: Levanta con las piernas, no con la espalda. | Recibido. Que no se te caiga en un pie.
english: Lift with your legs, not your back. | Copy. Don't drop it on your foot.

spanish: Muestra de {biome}. Está tan fría que quema. | Control, el suelo está a {temp_c} grados. La pala se ha pegado.
english: {biome} sample. It's so cold it burns. | Control, the ground is at {temp_c} degrees. The shovel stuck.

spanish: Usa los guantes buenos. | Anotado. Despega la pala con cuidado.
english: Use the good gloves. | Noted. Pry the shovel loose carefully.

spanish: Los materiales están a {temp_c} grados. Se han vuelto frágiles. | Control, frío extremo en la bahía. Las muestras crujen.
english: The materials are at {temp_c} degrees. They went brittle. | Control, extreme cold in the bay. The samples creak.

spanish: Perfecto. Eso es lo que queremos ver. | Anotado. No las golpees.
english: Perfect. That's what we want to see. | Noted. Don't knock them.

spanish: Bahía de materiales abierta en {here}. Muy lejos del taller. | Control, materiales expuestos a {here}.
english: Materials bay open at {here}. Far from the workshop. | Control, materials exposed to {here}.

spanish: Los ingenieros quieren saberlo todo. | Recibido. Ciérrala y tráelos a casa.
english: The engineers want to know everything. | Copy. Close it and bring them home.

spanish: Bahía de materiales abierta en pleno vuelo. Entra mucho aire. | Control, materiales al viento de {here}.
english: Materials bay open in flight. Lots of air coming in. | Control, materials in the wind of {here}.

spanish: Ciérrala antes de que salgan volando. | Anotado. Ahora cuenta las muestras.
english: Close it before they fly away. | Noted. Now count the samples.

spanish: Temperatura en {biome}: {temp_c} grados. | Control, el termómetro en el suelo de {here} marca {temp_c}.
english: Temperature in {biome}: {temp_c} degrees. | Control, the thermometer on the ground of {here} reads {temp_c}.

spanish: Anotado. ¿Hace falta chaqueta? | Recibido. Buen sitio para medir.
english: Noted. Jacket weather? | Copy. Good spot to measure.

spanish: Temperatura en vuelo: {temp_c} grados. | Control, a {alt_km} kilómetros el aire está a {temp_c}.
english: Temperature in flight: {temp_c} degrees. | Control, at {alt_km} km the air is at {temp_c}.

spanish: Recibido. El aire se enfría al subir. | Anotado. Buena lectura en marcha.
english: Copy. The air cools as you climb. | Noted. Good reading on the move.

spanish: {temp_c} grados en {here}. Nada que ver con Kerbin. | Control, el clima de {here} no se parece al de casa.
english: {temp_c} degrees on {here}. Nothing like Kerbin. | Control, the weather on {here} is nothing like home.

spanish: Anotado. Lo pondremos en la guía de viajes. | Recibido. Nadie va a ir de vacaciones allí.
english: Noted. It goes in the travel guide. | Copy. Nobody is going there on holiday.

spanish: Barómetro en {biome}: {press_kpa} kilopascales. | Control, presión en el suelo de {here} medida.
english: Barometer in {biome}: {press_kpa} kilopascals. | Control, pressure on the ground of {here} measured.

spanish: Recibido. Buen tiempo para estar de pie. | Anotado. Ahora ya sabemos qué aire respira la nave.
english: Copy. Good weather for standing around. | Noted. Now we know what air the ship breathes.

spanish: Presión en vuelo: {press_kpa} kilopascales. Baja al subir. | Control, a {alt_km} kilómetros el barómetro marca {press_kpa}.
english: Pressure in flight: {press_kpa} kilopascals. Dropping as we climb. | Control, at {alt_km} km the barometer reads {press_kpa}.

spanish: Anotado. Buen perfil de altura. | Recibido. Sigue subiendo, y midiendo.
english: Noted. Good altitude profile. | Copy. Keep climbing, and measuring.

spanish: El aire de {here} aprieta distinto. | Control, presión de {press_kpa} en {here}. Nada como casa.
english: The air of {here} presses differently. | Control, pressure of {press_kpa} on {here}. Nothing like home.

spanish: Anotado. Los meteorólogos están confundidos. | Recibido. Buen dato de lejos.
english: Noted. The weather people are confused. | Copy. Good data from far away.

spanish: El sismómetro escucha a Kerbin. Ronca tranquilo. | Control, el suelo de casa sigue en su sitio.
english: The seismometer listens to Kerbin. It snores calmly. | Control, the home ground is still in place.

spanish: Menos mal. Nos gusta así. | Recibido. Que siga roncando.
english: Good thing. We like it that way. | Copy. Let it keep snoring.

spanish: Con esta gravedad el suelo tiembla con fuerza. | Control, {here} tiembla pesado. {grav_g} ge.
english: With this gravity the ground shakes hard. | Control, {here} shakes heavy. {grav_g} g.

spanish: Anotado. Agárrate al sismómetro. | Recibido. Un planeta con carácter.
english: Noted. Hold on to the seismometer. | Copy. A planet with character.

spanish: Otro registro sísmico. Van {exp_runs}. | Control, el suelo ya me reconoce.
english: Another seismic record. That's {exp_runs}. | Control, the ground recognizes me by now.

spanish: Y nosotros a ti. Buen trabajo. | Recibido. El archivo de temblores está creciendo.
english: And so do we. Good work. | Copy. The tremor archive is growing.

spanish: Escaneo de gravedad desde órbita. {grav_g} ge a {alt_km} kilómetros. | Control, desde aquí arriba la gravedad sigue tirando.
english: Gravity scan from orbit. {grav_g} g at {alt_km} km. | Control, from up here gravity still pulls.

spanish: Siempre tira. Por eso orbitáis. | Anotado. Buen mapa desde arriba.
english: It always does. That's why you orbit. | Noted. Good map from above.

spanish: La gravedad de {here} es distinta. {grav_g} ge. | Control, en {here} peso otra cosa.
english: The gravity of {here} is different. {grav_g} g. | Control, on {here} I weigh something else.

spanish: Anotado. Ajustaremos la dieta. | Recibido. Buen dato para el mapa.
english: Noted. We'll adjust the diet. | Copy. Good data for the map.

spanish: Otro escaneo de gravedad. Van {exp_runs}. | Control, la gravedad sigue igual. La he medido otra vez.
english: Another gravity scan. That's {exp_runs}. | Control, gravity's still the same. I measured it again.

spanish: Bien. La gravedad es constante. Como tú. | Recibido. El mapa se está llenando.
english: Good. Gravity is constant. Like you. | Copy. The map is filling up.

spanish: Análisis del aire en {biome}. Hay algo raro en él. | Control, aire de {here} tomado a ras de suelo.
english: Air analysis in {biome}. There's something odd in it. | Control, {here} air taken at ground level.

spanish: Anotado. No te quites el casco. | Recibido. El aire de abajo dice mucho.
english: Noted. Keep your helmet on. | Copy. Low air tells a lot.

spanish: Análisis del aire en vuelo, a {alt_km} kilómetros. | Control, aire de {here} pasando por el tubo.
english: Air analysis in flight, at {alt_km} km. | Control, {here} air rushing through the tube.

spanish: Recibido. Una muestra con prisa. | Anotado. Cierra el tubo antes de que se escape.
english: Copy. A sample in a hurry. | Noted. Close the tube before it escapes.

spanish: El aire está a {temp_c} grados. Esto es un horno. | Control, aire caliente de {here}. Mucho.
english: The air is at {temp_c} degrees. This is an oven. | Control, hot air on {here}. Very.

spanish: Anotado. Que no se recaliente la nave. | Recibido. No abras las ventanas.
english: Noted. Don't let the ship overheat. | Copy. Don't open the windows.

spanish: Estoy de pie en el asteroide. Muestra tomada. | Control, muestra de asteroide tomada con los pies encima.
english: I'm standing on the asteroid. Sample taken. | Control, asteroid sample taken standing on it.

spanish: No saltes. Lo decimos en serio. | Recibido. Muy valiente. Muy raro.
english: Don't jump. We mean it. | Copy. Very brave. Very odd.

spanish: Muestra de asteroide a {alt_km} kilómetros de {here}. | Control, el asteroide y yo vamos juntos en órbita.
english: Asteroid sample at {alt_km} km above {here}. | Control, the asteroid and I are orbiting together.

spanish: Buen equipo. Que no se separe. | Recibido. Muestra y piedra, a buen ritmo.
english: Good team. Don't let it drift. | Copy. Sample and rock, keeping pace.

spanish: Control, esta muestra de asteroide es especial. Lo noto. | Un trozo de asteroide muy valioso, creo.
english: Control, this asteroid sample is special. I can tell. | A very valuable piece of asteroid, I think.

spanish: Lo es. {sci} puntos. Cuídala como a un hijo. | {sci} puntos. Los geólogos ya están en la puerta.
english: It is. {sci} points. Take care of it like a child. | {sci} points. The geologists are waiting at the door.

spanish: Muestra de cometa en órbita. Va tan rápido como nosotros. | Control, el cometa y yo vamos juntos. Por ahora.
english: Comet sample in orbit. It goes as fast as we do. | Control, the comet and I are traveling together. For now.

spanish: Aprovecha el viaje. No te durará. | Recibido. Despídete antes de que se vaya.
english: Make the most of the ride. It won't last. | Copy. Say goodbye before it leaves.

spanish: Control, este hielo de cometa brilla mucho. Creo que vale mucho. | Muestra de cometa especial, creo.
english: Control, this comet ice shines a lot. I think it's worth a lot. | A special comet sample, I think.

spanish: Brilla y vale. {sci} puntos. | {sci} puntos. El laboratorio prepara el congelador grande.
english: It shines and it pays. {sci} points. | {sci} points. The lab is clearing the big freezer.

spanish: Estoy de pie en un cometa. Esto resbala. | Control, muestra tomada desde la superficie del cometa.
english: I'm standing on a comet. It's slippery. | Control, sample taken from the comet's surface.

spanish: Agárrate a algo. Lo que sea. | Recibido. Increíble. No te caigas.
english: Hold on to something. Anything. | Copy. Incredible. Don't fall off.

spanish: Telescopio apuntando lejos de Kerbin. Muchas estrellas. | Control, desde casa el cielo se ve bien igual.
english: Telescope pointing away from Kerbin. Lots of stars. | Control, the sky looks good from home too.

spanish: Recibido. Busca algo que no conozcamos. | Bien. Pero no apuntes al sol.
english: Copy. Find something we don't know. | Good. But don't point at the sun.

spanish: Otra imagen infrarroja. Van {exp_runs}. | Control, ya tengo un álbum entero de puntos.
english: Another infrared image. That's {exp_runs}. | Control, I have a whole album of dots now.

spanish: Haremos una exposición. | Recibido. El laboratorio pide menos puntos y más estrellas.
english: We'll hold an exhibition. | Copy. The lab asks for fewer dots and more stars.

spanish: Control, el telescopio ha visto algo grande. Muy grande. | Imagen infrarroja muy rica. Creo que vale mucho.
english: Control, the telescope saw something big. Very big. | A very rich infrared image. I think it's worth a lot.

spanish: Lo es. {sci} puntos. Guarda esa imagen. | {sci} puntos. Los astrónomos no pueden dormir.
english: It is. {sci} points. Keep that image. | {sci} points. The astronomers can't sleep.

spanish: Magnetómetro en el suelo de {biome}. Las rocas lo confunden. | Control, campo magnético medido a ras de {here}.
english: Magnetometer on the ground of {biome}. The rocks confuse it. | Control, magnetic field measured at ground level on {here}.

spanish: Anotado. Las rocas también tienen opinión. | Recibido. Buen dato de cerca.
english: Noted. The rocks have opinions too. | Copy. Good data up close.

spanish: El campo de Kerbin, medido. El norte sigue arriba. | Control, el campo de casa no ha cambiado.
english: Kerbin's field, measured. North is still up. | Control, the home field hasn't changed.

spanish: Menos mal. Las brújulas lo agradecen. | Recibido. Que siga así.
english: Good thing. The compasses are grateful. | Copy. Long may it last.

spanish: Otra lectura magnética. Van {exp_runs}. | Control, el magnetómetro ya conoce mi cara.
english: Another magnetic reading. That's {exp_runs}. | Control, the magnetometer knows my face by now.

spanish: Y tu llavero. Buen trabajo. | Recibido. El mapa del campo crece.
english: And your keychain. Good work. | Copy. The field map is growing.

spanish: Esta roca casi flota. Con esta gravedad todo es ligero. | Control, estudio la roca sin que se me escape. Cuesta.
english: This rock almost floats. Everything is light with this gravity. | Control, studying the rock without it getting away. It's hard.

spanish: No la empujes. Puede irse. | Recibido. Agárrala con suavidad.
english: Don't push it. It might leave. | Copy. Hold it gently.

spanish: Mi primera visita a {here} y ya encuentro una roca rara. | Control, recién llegado a {here} y mira qué roca.
english: My first visit to {here} and I already found an odd rock. | Control, just got to {here} and look at this rock.

spanish: Tienes buen ojo, {kerbal}. | Qué suerte. Hazle una foto para el álbum.
english: You have a good eye, {kerbal}. | Lucky you. Take a photo for the album.

spanish: Control, esta formación es enorme. Creo que es importante. | Una roca muy especial en {biome}.
english: Control, this formation is huge. I think it matters. | A very special rock in {biome}.

spanish: Lo es. {sci} puntos. Los geólogos se han puesto de pie. | {sci} puntos. Esta roca va al museo.
english: It does. {sci} points. The geologists stood up. | {sci} points. This rock is going to the museum.

id: # Batch talks: the experiments run close together, in one talk. Line 1 checks exp_count (exp_count>=2), only a
# batch uses those. {exp_count} is how many, {exp_list} names them, {sci} is the total and {sci_first} is 1 when all

spanish: Control, mando todo junto: {exp_list}. | Control, van varios experimentos a la vez. | Paquete de ciencia en camino: {exp_list}.
english: Control, sending it all together: {exp_list}. | Control, several experiments coming at once. | Science package on the way: {exp_list}.

spanish: Recibido todo. {sci} puntos en total. | Todo recibido. Buen paquete. | Recibido, {kerbal}. {exp_count} experimentos, {sci} puntos.
english: Got it all. {sci} points in total. | All received. Nice package. | Copy, {kerbal}. {exp_count} experiments, {sci} points.

spanish: Tengo las manos llenas. {exp_list}, todo hecho. | Uf. {exp_count} experimentos seguidos. | Todo a la vez, Control. No me preguntes cómo.
english: My hands are full. {exp_list}, all done. | Phew. {exp_count} experiments in a row. | All at once, Control. Don't ask me how.

spanish: Se nota. Buen trabajo. | Lo vemos todo. {sci} puntos de golpe. | Calma, {kerbal}. Respira. Lo hiciste todo.
english: We can tell. Good work. | We see it all. {sci} points in one go. | Easy, {kerbal}. Breathe. You did it all.

spanish: Pulsé todos los botones de ciencia. Todos. | Hice {exp_list}. Sin pausa. | Fiesta de botones aquí arriba.
english: I pressed every science button. Every one. | I did {exp_list}. No break. | Button party up here.

spanish: Ya lo vemos. Las pantallas se volvieron locas. | Fiesta aprobada. {sci} puntos. | Bien hecho. Deja algún botón para mañana.
english: We see it. The screens went wild. | Party approved. {sci} points. | Well done. Leave a button for tomorrow.

spanish: Inventario de ciencia: {exp_list}. | Lista de hoy: {exp_count} experimentos. | Tengo una lista de experimentos para ti.
english: Science inventory: {exp_list}. | Today's list: {exp_count} experiments. | I have a list of experiments for you.

spanish: Lista anotada. Todo en orden. | Anotado todo. Suma {sci} puntos. | Gracias. La lista ya está en la pared.
english: List noted. All in order. | All noted. It adds up to {sci} points. | Thanks. The list is on the wall already.

spanish: Todo de una vez desde {here}: {exp_list}. | Datos de {here}, varios a la vez. | Varios experimentos listos. Todos de aquí.
english: All in one go from {here}: {exp_list}. | Data from {here}, several at once. | Several experiments ready. All from here.

spanish: Recibido. {here} da mucho de sí. | Recibido. Buena cosecha. | {sci} puntos de una vez. Bonito.
english: Copy. {here} has a lot to give. | Copy. Good harvest. | {sci} points at once. Nice.

spanish: Cosecha de ciencia lista, Control. | Recogí {exp_list}. Todo fresco. | Temporada de cosecha. {exp_count} experimentos.
english: Science harvest is in, Control. | I gathered {exp_list}. All fresh. | Harvest season. {exp_count} experiments.

spanish: Buena cosecha. {sci} puntos al granero. | Al granero con todo. | Recibido. Los granjeros de abajo están contentos.
english: Good harvest. {sci} points to the barn. | All of it to the barn. | Copy. The farmers down here are happy.

spanish: Control, aquí va todo: {exp_list}. | Hice varios experimentos de golpe. | Todo listo. {exp_count} experimentos.
english: Control, here it all comes: {exp_list}. | Did several experiments in one go. | All ready. {exp_count} experiments.

spanish: Más despacio, {kerbal}. El becario no da abasto. | Ay. El becario se cayó de la silla. | Recibido, pero el becario pide un descanso.
english: Slow down, {kerbal}. The intern can't keep up. | Ouch. The intern fell off the chair. | Copy, but the intern wants a break.

spanish: Dile que se agarre fuerte. | Lo siento por el becario.
english: Tell them to hold on tight. | Sorry, intern.

spanish: Lista de ciencia: {exp_list}. Hecho, hecho y hecho. | Lista de ciencia completa. | Lista terminada. {exp_count} de {exp_count}.
english: Science checklist: {exp_list}. Done, done and done. | Science checklist complete. | Checklist finished. {exp_count} of {exp_count}.

spanish: Todo marcado. Buen trabajo. | Marcado. {sci} puntos. | Lista anotada. Te ganaste una pegatina.
english: All ticked. Good work. | Ticked. {sci} points. | Checklist noted. You earned a sticker.

spanish: Control, tengo {exp_list}. ¿Cuál quieres primero? | Tengo varios datos. ¿Por cuál empiezo?
english: Control, I have {exp_list}. Which one first? | I have several results. Where do I start?

spanish: Todos a la vez. Ya están aquí. | Da igual. Los tenemos todos.
english: All at once. They're here already. | Doesn't matter. We have them all.

spanish: Qué rápido. | Vale. Más fácil así.
english: That was fast. | OK. Easier that way.

spanish: {kerbal}, nos llegan muchos datos a la vez. | Control aquí. ¿Has hecho todos los experimentos? | Recibimos {exp_count} experimentos de golpe.
english: {kerbal}, we're getting a lot of data at once. | Control here. Did you run every experiment? | We got {exp_count} experiments in one go.

spanish: Sí. {exp_list}. Todos. | Todos. No había cola. | Sí. Estaban ahí y tenían botón.
english: Yes. {exp_list}. All of them. | All of them. There was no queue. | Yes. They were there and had a button.

spanish: Muy bien. {sci} puntos en total. | Muy bien. Sigue así.
english: Very good. {sci} points in total. | Very good. Keep it up.

spanish: {kerbal}, contamos {exp_count} experimentos. ¿Correcto? | Control aquí. Cuento varios paquetes de datos.
english: {kerbal}, we count {exp_count} experiments. Correct? | Control here. I count several data packages.

spanish: Correcto. {exp_list}. | Correcto. Todo lo que había.
english: Correct. {exp_list}. | Correct. Everything there was.

spanish: Perfecto. Todo cuadra. | Cuadra. Son {sci} puntos.
english: Perfect. It all adds up. | It adds up. That's {sci} points.

spanish: Control, hay un montón de datos para ti. | Un montón de datos: {exp_list}.
english: Control, there's a pile of data for you. | A pile of data: {exp_list}.

spanish: Ponlo en el montón grande. | Montón anotado. Vale {sci} puntos.
english: Put it on the big pile. | Pile noted. Worth {sci} points.

spanish: Hice todo seguido. {exp_list}. | Uno tras otro, Control. Todos.
english: I did it all back to back. {exp_list}. | One after another, Control. All of them.

spanish: Anotado uno tras otro. Gracias. | Recibido. {exp_count} experimentos, {sci} puntos.
english: Noted one after another. Thanks. | Copy. {exp_count} experiments, {sci} points.

spanish: Buen día de ciencia, Control. {exp_list}. | Día {day}. Buen día para la ciencia. | Hoy es un buen día para la ciencia.
english: Good science day, Control. {exp_list}. | Day {day}. A good day for science. | Today is a good day for science.

spanish: Muy bueno. {sci} puntos de un golpe. | Un día excelente. Lo celebramos aquí abajo.
english: Very good. {sci} points in one go. | An excellent day. We're celebrating down here.

spanish: ¿Para qué hacerlos uno a uno? Lo hice todo. | Lo hice todo de una vez. {exp_list}. Me ahorro tiempo.
english: Why do them one by one? Did it all. | Did it all at once. {exp_list}. Saves time.

spanish: Eficiente. Nos gusta. | Muy eficiente. {sci} puntos por el precio de uno.
english: Efficient. We like it. | Very efficient. {sci} points for the price of one.

spanish: Aquí hay mucho ruido de máquinas. Todo funciona. | Todo zumba y pita. {exp_list}, listo.
english: Lots of machine noise up here. It all works. | Everything hums and beeps. {exp_list}, done.

spanish: Suena a ciencia. Recibido. | El zumbido vale {sci} puntos.
english: Sounds like science. Copy. | The humming is worth {sci} points.

spanish: {vessel} es un laboratorio ahora mismo. {exp_list}. | Esta nave es un laboratorio ahora mismo.
english: {vessel} is a lab right now. {exp_list}. | This ship is a lab right now.

spanish: El mejor laboratorio con ventanas. | Laboratorio aprobado. {sci} puntos.
english: The best lab with windows. | Lab approved. {sci} points.

spanish: Barrido completo de {biome}: {exp_list}. | Barrido completo de la zona.
english: Full sweep of {biome}: {exp_list}. | Full sweep of the area.

spanish: Recibido. Ya nadie tiene que volver ahí. | Barrido anotado. Vale {sci} puntos.
english: Copy. Nobody has to go back there. | Sweep noted. Worth {sci} points.

spanish: Listo. {exp_count} experimentos. Necesito sentarme. | Listo todo. Necesito un descanso.
english: Done. {exp_count} experiments. I need to sit down. | All done. I need a break.

spanish: Ya estás sentado, {kerbal}. | Descansa. Te lo ganaste.
english: You are sitting already, {kerbal}. | Rest. You earned it.

spanish: Control, ¿cuántos experimentos llevo? | Control, perdí la cuenta de los experimentos.
english: Control, how many experiments is that? | Control, I lost count of the experiments.

spanish: {exp_count}. {exp_list}. | Muchos. Los anotamos todos.
english: {exp_count}. {exp_list}. | Lots. We noted them all.

spanish: Vacié el cajón de experimentos: {exp_list}. | Vacié el cajón de experimentos.
english: I emptied the experiment drawer: {exp_list}. | I emptied the experiment drawer.

spanish: Bien. Ahora ordénalo. | Cajón vacío, {sci} puntos llenos.
english: Good. Now tidy it up. | Empty drawer, {sci} points full.

spanish: Todos los instrumentos a la vez. Como una orquesta. | Concierto de ciencia: {exp_list}.
english: Every instrument at once. Like an orchestra. | Science concert: {exp_list}.

spanish: Bravo. Un concierto de {sci} puntos. | Bravo. Otra, otra.
english: Bravo. A {sci} point concert. | Bravo. Encore, encore.

spanish: Control, hice {exp_count} experimentos. Sí, {exp_count}. | Esto es mucha ciencia a la vez: {exp_list}.
english: Control, I ran {exp_count} experiments. Yes, {exp_count}. | This is a lot of science at once: {exp_list}.

spanish: ¿{exp_count}? El ordenador está sudando. | Recibido. El ordenador hace ruidos raros.
english: {exp_count}? The computer is sweating. | Copy. The computer is making weird noises.

spanish: Que no se queme. | Dale un abanico.
english: Don't let it burn. | Give it a fan.

spanish: {exp_count} experimentos de una vez. ¿Es un récord?
english: {exp_count} experiments at once. Is that a record?

spanish: Creo que sí. Lo apuntamos en la pizarra. | Puede ser. {sci} puntos seguro que sí.
english: I think so. We're writing it on the board. | Could be. {sci} points certainly is.

spanish: Dos experimentos, Control: {exp_list}. | Van dos experimentos juntos.
english: Two experiments, Control: {exp_list}. | Two experiments coming together.

spanish: Dos recibidos. Una pareja perfecta. | Los dos llegaron. {sci} puntos.
english: Two received. A perfect pair. | Both arrived. {sci} points.

spanish: Tres experimentos: {exp_list}. | Tres de una vez, Control.
english: Three experiments: {exp_list}. | Three in one go, Control.

spanish: Tres de tres. Bien. | Los tres anotados. Valen {sci} puntos.
english: Three for three. Good. | All three noted. Worth {sci} points.

spanish: Todo esto es nuevo, Control. {exp_list}. Nadie lo hizo antes aquí. | Datos nuevos, todos. Nadie los tenía.
english: All of this is new, Control. {exp_list}. Nobody did it here before. | New data, all of it. Nobody had it.

spanish: Todo nuevo. {sci} puntos. Los científicos aplauden. | Primera vez para todo. Qué bonito.
english: All new. {sci} points. The scientists are clapping. | A first for everything. How nice.

spanish: Control, creo que esto vale mucho: {exp_list}. | Control, esto pesa mucho en ciencia.
english: Control, I think this is worth a lot: {exp_list}. | Control, this is heavy on science.

spanish: Vale {sci} puntos. Es mucho. | {sci} puntos. Alguien está llorando de alegría aquí.
english: It's worth {sci} points. That's a lot. | {sci} points. Someone is crying with joy here.

spanish: Terminé {exp_list}. Seguro que vale algo. | Hice varios experimentos. Algo valdrán.
english: Finished {exp_list}. Surely it's worth something. | Ran several experiments. They must be worth something.

spanish: Vale {sci} puntos. Entre todos. | Poco, la verdad. Ya lo sabíamos todo.
english: It's worth {sci} points. All together. | Not much, honestly. We knew it all already.

spanish: Bueno. La intención cuenta. | Al menos lo intenté.
english: Well. It's the thought that counts. | At least I tried.

spanish: Protocolo completo, Control. {exp_list}. Todo calibrado. | Protocolo completo. Todo calibrado y anotado.
english: Full protocol, Control. {exp_list}. All calibrated. | Full protocol. All calibrated and noted.

spanish: Así trabaja un profesional. Recibido. | Impecable, {kerbal}. {sci} puntos.
english: That's how a pro works. Copy. | Flawless, {kerbal}. {sci} points.

spanish: Control, estoy en el paraíso. {exp_list}. Todo a la vez. | Control, este es el mejor día de mi carrera.
english: Control, I'm in paradise. {exp_list}. All at once. | Control, this is the best day of my career.

spanish: Disfruta, {kerbal}. Es tu momento. | Lo oímos en tu voz. {sci} puntos.
english: Enjoy it, {kerbal}. It's your moment. | We can hear it in your voice. {sci} points.

spanish: Con los pies en el suelo y las manos en la ciencia: {exp_list}. | Aterrizados y midiendo todo.
english: Feet on the ground, hands on the science: {exp_list}. | Landed and measuring everything.

spanish: Así se aprovecha un aterrizaje. | Aterrizaje rentable. {sci} puntos.
english: That's how you make use of a landing. | A profitable landing. {sci} points.

spanish: Mido todo en el salto: {exp_list}. | Todo medido antes de bajar.
english: Measuring it all during the hop: {exp_list}. | All measured before we come down.

spanish: Rápido y bien. Recibido. | Recibido. {sci} puntos en un salto.
english: Quick and good. Copy. | Copy. {sci} points in one hop.

spanish: Una vuelta, muchos datos: {exp_list}. | Todo medido en órbita.
english: One lap, lots of data: {exp_list}. | Everything measured in orbit.

spanish: Órbita productiva. Recibido. | Recibido. {sci} puntos en una vuelta.
english: A productive orbit. Copy. | Copy. {sci} points in one lap.

spanish: Mido todo mientras vuelo: {exp_list}. | Todo medido en pleno vuelo.
english: Measuring everything while I fly: {exp_list}. | All measured in mid flight.

spanish: Ojos en el horizonte, por favor. | Recibido. Ahora vuela recto.
english: Eyes on the horizon, please. | Copy. Now fly straight.

spanish: Desde {body}: {exp_list}. | Mucha ciencia desde muy lejos.
english: From {body}: {exp_list}. | Lots of science from far away.

spanish: Llegó todo, aunque tardó. Recibido. | Recibido. {sci} puntos de muy lejos.
english: It all arrived, slowly. Copy. | Copy. {sci} points from far away.

spanish: Hecho: {exp_list}. ¿Cuánto llevamos en el vuelo? | Más ciencia. ¿Cuánto llevamos ya?
english: Done: {exp_list}. How much is this flight at? | More science. How much do we have now?

spanish: {sci_flight} puntos en este vuelo. Nada mal.
english: {sci_flight} points this flight. Not bad.

spanish: Hago todo con estos guantes enormes. {exp_list}. | Todo con guantes. Fue difícil.
english: Doing it all in these huge gloves. {exp_list}. | All in gloves. It was hard.

spanish: Muy bien. Ni un dedo perdido. | Recibido. Guantes de oro, {kerbal}.
english: Very good. Not a finger lost. | Copy. Golden gloves, {kerbal}.

id: # Sent or kept: data_sent=1 when the data went out by antenna, data_sent=0 when it was kept aboard. A line that says
# the data arrived needs data_sent=1. Without the value (a batch with both) only talks without the check fit.

spanish: Control, tengo los datos de {exp}. Los guardo aquí. | Datos guardados a bordo, Control.
english: Control, I have the {exp} data. Keeping it here. | Data stored aboard, Control.

spanish: Bien. Cuídalos y tráelos a casa. | Recibido. Que no se pierdan.
english: Good. Look after it and bring it home. | Copy. Don't lose them.

spanish: Guardé los datos en el cajón. Al lado de los bocadillos. | Los datos de {exp} van al cajón.
english: I put the data in the drawer. Next to the sandwiches. | The {exp} data goes in the drawer.

spanish: Lejos de los bocadillos, por favor. | Buen sitio. Que nadie se los coma.
english: Away from the sandwiches, please. | Good spot. Don't let anyone eat it.

spanish: Me quedo con los datos. Los llevo a casa. | Datos de {here} a bordo. Vuelven conmigo.
english: I'm keeping the data. Taking it home. | Data from {here} aboard. It comes back with me.

spanish: Perfecto. En casa valen más. | Entendido. Te esperamos con los datos.
english: Perfect. They're worth more at home. | Understood. We'll be waiting for you and the data.

spanish: Control, no mando nada todavía. Lo guardo. | Hago el experimento, pero no lo mando.
english: Control, not sending anything yet. Storing it. | Running the experiment, but not sending it.

spanish: Buena idea. Nada se pierde así. | Recibido. Lo veremos cuando vuelvas.
english: Good idea. Nothing gets lost that way. | Copy. We'll see it when you're back.

spanish: Datos guardados. ¿Te cuento lo que vi? | Lo tengo guardado. ¿Te lo cuento por radio?
english: Data stored. Want me to tell you what I saw? | I have it stored. Shall I tell you over the radio?

spanish: Sí, cuéntalo. Los datos de verdad, luego. | Cuéntalo. Pero guarda bien los números.
english: Yes, tell us. The real data later. | Tell us. But keep the numbers safe.

spanish: Pues fue bonito. Eso es todo. | Fue interesante. Más no sé decir.
english: Well, it was pretty. That's it. | It was interesting. That's all I can say.

spanish: Le puse una etiqueta a los datos: {here}, día {day}. | Datos guardados y con etiqueta.
english: I labeled the data: {here}, day {day}. | Data stored and labeled.

spanish: Muy ordenado. Así nos gusta. | Etiqueta aprobada. Tráelo a casa.
english: Very tidy. That's how we like it. | Label approved. Bring it home.

spanish: {kerbal}, ¿no mandas los datos? | Control aquí. No nos llega nada. ¿Lo guardas?
english: {kerbal}, you're not sending the data? | Control here. Nothing is coming in. Are you keeping it?

spanish: No. Los guardo. En casa valen más. | Lo guardo para luego.
english: No. I'm keeping it. It's worth more at home. | I'm keeping it for later.

spanish: Bien pensado. | Vale. Cuídalos bien.
english: Good thinking. | OK. Look after it well.

spanish: {kerbal}, nos dicen que tienes datos de {exp}. | Control aquí. ¿Tienes algo para nosotros?
english: {kerbal}, we hear you have {exp} data. | Control here. Got anything for us?

spanish: Lo tengo, pero se queda aquí. Paciencia. | Sí, pero lo guardo. Tendréis que esperar.
english: I have it, but it stays here. Patience. | Yes, but I'm keeping it. You'll have to wait.

spanish: Los científicos odian esperar. | Esperaremos. Sin prisa.
english: The scientists hate waiting. | We'll wait. No rush.

spanish: Control, esto parece valioso. Lo guardo. | Esto vale mucho. No lo mando por radio.
english: Control, this looks valuable. Keeping it. | This is worth a lot. Not sending it by radio.

spanish: Bien. Vale {sci} puntos. Tráelo entero. | Buena idea. En casa vale {sci} puntos.
english: Good. It's worth {sci} points. Bring it back whole. | Good idea. At home it's worth {sci} points.

spanish: Datos de {body} a bordo. Es un viaje largo hasta casa. | Los datos se quedan conmigo. Hay mucho camino.
english: Data from {body} aboard. It's a long way home. | The data stays with me. It's a long way.

spanish: No te los olvides en {body}. | Que vuelvan contigo. Y tú también.
english: Don't forget it on {body}. | Make sure it comes back with you. And you too.

spanish: Guardo la muestra de moco. El bote está bien cerrado. | Moco guardado. No se escapa.
english: Keeping the goo sample. The canister is shut tight. | Goo stored. It's not getting out.

spanish: Bien. El moco viaja mejor que la radio. | Perfecto. Por radio el moco pierde mucho.
english: Good. Goo travels better than radio. | Perfect. Goo loses a lot over the radio.

spanish: Cierro la bahía de materiales. Los datos se quedan dentro. | Materiales guardados. No los mando.
english: Closing the materials bay. The data stays inside. | Materials stored. Not sending them.

spanish: Bien hecho. Así valen mucho más. | Recibido. Tráelos a casa.
english: Well done. They're worth much more that way. | Copy. Bring them home.

spanish: Muestra de {biome} guardada en la bolsa. | La muestra de suelo va en la bolsa.
english: Sample from {biome} in the bag. | The surface sample goes in the bag.

spanish: Bien. Una piedra en la bolsa vale más que una por radio. | Que no se caiga la bolsa.
english: Good. A rock in the bag is worth more than one over the radio. | Don't drop the bag.

spanish: Informe de paseo guardado en el traje. | Tengo el informe en el traje.
english: EVA report stored in the suit. | I have the report in my suit.

spanish: Bien. Que no se moje el traje. | Recibido. Al volver a bordo, guárdalo bien.
english: Good. Keep the suit dry. | Copy. When you get back aboard, store it well.

spanish: Informe de tripulación escrito y guardado. | Informe escrito. Se queda en la carpeta.
english: Crew report written and stored. | Report written. It stays in the folder.

spanish: Bien. Lo leeremos en casa. | Recibido. Que no se manche.
english: Good. We'll read it at home. | Copy. Don't get it dirty.

spanish: Control, guardo todo a bordo: {exp_list}. | Hice {exp_count} experimentos. Todos guardados.
english: Control, keeping it all aboard: {exp_list}. | Ran {exp_count} experiments. All stored.

spanish: Bien. Una buena carga para traer a casa. | Recibido. Cuida esa carga.
english: Good. A nice load to bring home. | Copy. Look after that load.

spanish: La estantería de datos está llena: {exp_list}. | Ya no cabe más en la estantería.
english: The data shelf is full: {exp_list}. | The shelf can't take any more.

spanish: Tráela entera. Con cuidado. | Buena carga. No frenes de golpe.
english: Bring it back whole. Carefully. | Nice load. No sudden braking.

spanish: {kerbal}, vemos {exp_count} experimentos, pero no nos llega nada. | Control aquí. ¿Te lo guardas todo?
english: {kerbal}, we see {exp_count} experiments, but nothing is coming in. | Control here. Keeping it all?

spanish: Sí. {exp_list}. Todo vuelve conmigo. | Sí. Todo vuelve conmigo.
english: Yes. {exp_list}. It all comes back with me. | Yes. It all comes back with me.

spanish: Entendido. Te esperamos. | Vale. Vuelve con todo.
english: Understood. We'll be waiting. | OK. Come back with all of it.

spanish: Tengo un tesoro de datos a bordo. {exp_list}. | Tengo un tesoro de datos a bordo.
english: I have a treasure of data aboard. {exp_list}. | I have a treasure of data aboard.

spanish: Pues no lo pierdas. Vale {sci} puntos. | Tráelo a casa, pirata.
english: Then don't lose it. It's worth {sci} points. | Bring it home, pirate.

spanish: Todo hecho y guardado. Lo mando más tarde, o lo llevo. | Guardo {exp_list}. Ya veremos qué mando.
english: All done and stored. I'll send it later, or bring it. | Storing {exp_list}. We'll see what I send.

spanish: Tú decides, {kerbal}. | Bien. Sin prisa.
english: Your call, {kerbal}. | Good. No rush.

spanish: Control, mando {exp_list} por la antena. | La antena está trabajando. Va todo.
english: Control, sending {exp_list} over the antenna. | The antenna is working. It's all going.

spanish: Lo vemos llegar. Bonito. | Recibido todo. {sci} puntos.
english: We see it coming in. Nice. | Got it all. {sci} points.

spanish: Datos de {exp} enviados, Control. | Datos enviados por la antena.
english: {exp} data sent, Control. | Data sent over the antenna.

spanish: Ya están aquí. Gracias. | Recibidos. {sci} puntos.
english: They're here already. Thanks. | Received. {sci} points.

spanish: La antena va despacio, pero va. | Mandando datos. La barra se mueve.
english: The antenna is slow, but it's going. | Sending data. The bar is moving.

spanish: Paciencia. Llegará. | Lo vemos llegar poco a poco.
english: Patience. It will get here. | We see it coming in, bit by bit.
